Although auditors do not provide direct assurance of non-GAAP earnings, some investors may consider them a more informative metric than GAAP earnings, aligned with management's view that non-GAAP is a more accurate reflection of the company's performance (Anderson et al., 2022). Yet, some investors may consider non-GAAP earnings as management's opportunistic attempt to enhance reported performance, consistent with regulators' advice to exercise ‘appropriate and healthy skepticism’ (Securities and Exchange Commission, 2001; Garavaglia, 2023). Audit standard setters have mandated that auditors include critical audit matters (hereafter “CAMs”) in audit reports (IAASB, 2015; FRC, 2016; PCAOB, 2017).1 CAMs highlight areas of significant subjectivity and complexity in financial reporting, often involving assumptions that yield a range of reasonable estimates. Notably, auditors' CAM disclosures often focus on financial statement items, such as goodwill impairment, that managers also select as key drivers of the difference between GAAP and non-GAAP earnings (Henry et al., 2020).2 Our paper examines how investors respond when management's non-GAAP earnings either include or exclude a financial statement item identified as a CAM.When GAAP and non-GAAP earnings are disclosed together, investors have multiple earnings metrics to consider, one audited and one constructed at management's discretion. Non-GAAP adjustments often depict performance in a more favorable light than the GAAP metric, such as shifting from a GAAP loss to a non-GAAP profit. In such cases, when the adjustment involves a CAM item, already identified by auditors as complex and subjective, it may heighten investors' scrutiny of management's motives, particularly management's credibility and its components, competence and trustworthiness (Anderson et al., 2022; Golden, 2017; Mercer, 2005; Williams, 1996). Because CAM disclosures reveal complexity, investors may question management's competence to estimate such items accurately. Similarly, the subjectivity of CAMs raises concerns about bias and opportunism, potentially undermining management's trustworthiness (Rapley et al., 2021).Given that non-GAAP adjustments are often used to portray performance more favorably than GAAP earnings metrics, regulators emphasize the need for investor skepticism and encourage critical evaluation of management's non-GAAP choices (SEC, 2022). Standard setters also recognize the diversity of investor perspectives and engage with investor groups holding both long and short positions (FASB, 2022).3 In light of regulators' desire to ensure financial reporting provides useful information to a wide range of investors, and guided by psychology theories on motivated reasoning, we test our theory across long and short investors. We predict that investors' management credibility judgments and information-seeking behaviors in response to management's non-GAAP reporting will differ depending on investors' position in the company's shares.Using an experimental approach, we test how management's non-GAAP treatment of a CAM item and investors' long or short positions jointly influence judgments of management credibility and information search behavior. We focus on a setting where GAAP earnings show a loss for three reasons. First, non-GAAP earnings are often more positive than GAAP earnings (Garavaglia, 2023; Elliott, 2006). Consistent with this, our own analysis of a sample of firm data reveals that when GAAP earnings show a loss, firms report a non-GAAP profit about half the time; whereas when GAAP earnings show a profit, firms rarely report a non-GAAP loss.4 Second, using a GAAP loss context allows us to test contrasting investor reactions when non-GAAP earnings either remain a loss or shift to a small profit, aligning with Kerlinger and Lee's (2000) principle to maximize experimental differences along the theoretical construct of interest. Third, a GAAP loss setting is practically relevant because investors demand more information in loss contexts, and managers have incentives to disclose non-GAAP earnings to mitigate negative market reactions to losses (Leung & Veenman, 2018).In all conditions, auditors identify goodwill impairment loss as a CAM item. Our experiment varies whether managers exclude this impairment from non-GAAP earnings. Excluding the impairment increases non-GAAP earnings relative to GAAP, turning a GAAP loss into a small non-GAAP profit. Prior research in psychology suggests that individuals' directional preferences influence how they process information (Kunda, 1990). Investors holding a long position in a company prefer higher earnings, while short investors prefer lower earnings. Excluding the impairment in non-GAAP earnings is consistent with long, but not short, investors' preferences since it results in a non-GAAP profit. We predict that, relative to when management's treatment of a CAM item results in a non-GAAP loss, when management's treatment of a CAM item reveals a non-GAAP profit, long investors will increase, but short investors will decrease, their management credibility judgments.We further hypothesize that long investors, faced with a GAAP loss inconsistent with their preference for higher earnings, will be particularly receptive to information about alternative measures of performance (Ditto & Lopez, 1992). When management uses a CAM item to turn a GAAP loss into a non-GAAP profit, we expect long investors to be receptive to details supporting management's non-GAAP choice. Accordingly, we expect long investors to seek details from management's note disclosure, enhancing perceived management credibility. Conversely, when management's non-GAAP choice surrounding the CAM item leads to a non-GAAP loss, we expect long investors to be less likely to seek information to support management's non-GAAP treatment and more likely to seek details that may cast doubt on it. Accordingly, we expect long investors' search behavior to shift more toward the auditor's discussion of CAM items relative to management's note disclosure. We expect that long investors' greater relative attention to CAM disclosures will decrease management credibility as investors are reminded of the subjectivity and complexity of the CAM items and the ensuing negative implications of these features on management's trustworthiness and competence, respectively (Rapley et al., 2021).In contrast to long investors, a GAAP loss is already consistent with short investors' preference for low earnings. Thus, we expect short investors to be less inclined to search management or auditor disclosures for details about non-GAAP earnings. Yet, motivated reasoning theory posits that short investors will interpret management's non-GAAP choices through a directional-preference lens, forming lower (higher) assessments of management credibility when management's choices reveal a small non-GAAP profit (loss).To test our predictions, we conduct a 2 × 2 between-participants experiment in which participants are randomly assigned to an investment position (long or short), and a non-GAAP earnings treatment (a small non-GAAP profit or loss is reported due to different treatments of a CAM item). All participants receive the same GAAP financial statements, reporting the same GAAP net loss. We manipulate the non-GAAP earnings by either including or excluding a CAM item (i.e., goodwill impairment loss) from non-GAAP earnings. Excluding the impairment loss changes a GAAP loss to a small non-GAAP profit, while including it results in a non-GAAP loss. To manipulate investment position, we adapt an ownership-inducing task from prior accounting research that strengthens our manipulation of investors’ directional preferences (Fanning et al., 2015; Thayer, 2011).Consistent with our predictions, we find that when management excludes the CAM item to reveal a small non-GAAP profit, long investors increase, but short investors decrease, their judgments of management credibility, relative to when management's choices reveal a non-GAAP loss. We find evidence that the joint effect is explained by differences in investors' information search behavior. That is, relative to when non-GAAP reveals a small profit, when non-GAAP reveals a loss, long investors attend more to the auditor's CAM disclosures and less to managers' note disclosures. Conversely, short investors' information search behavior is relatively insensitive to management's choice for non-GAAP earnings. As a supplementary test, we find that investors' management credibility judgments are significantly associated with investors' earnings judgments.To evaluate the generalizability of our theoretical framework, we conduct a supplemental experiment in a GAAP profit setting. This experiment reverses investor directional preferences relative to our GAAP loss context by examining a context where GAAP earnings are positive and the CAM adjustment either amplifies profits or moves earnings to a small loss. The results provide additional support for our theory, showing that investor preferences continue to influence judgment and information search across reporting contexts, though the specific credibility cues emphasized shift away from management and toward the auditor.Our study has a number of important contributions. First, we extend the accounting literatures on non-GAAP earnings (for example, Elliott, 2006; Anderson et al., 2022; Garavaglia, 2023) and CAM disclosures (for example, Christensen et al., 2014; Gimbar et al., 2016; Kang, 2019; Bentley et al., 2021; Tan & Yeo, 2022) by demonstrating how managers’ treatment of CAM items in non-GAAP earnings influences investor judgments and information search behavior, despite the lack of auditor assurance on non-GAAP earnings metrics. These results are informative to regulators and managers interested in how CAM items, common in non-GAAP disclosures, affect the credibility of managers and related investment judgments.Second, we contribute to the literature on investors’ directional preferences (Fanning et al., 2015; Hales, 2007; Hales et al., 2011; Han & Tan, 2010; Thayer, 2011) by illustrating how long and short investors differ in their credibility judgments and information search behavior in response to multiple earnings metrics. Jackson Jr. bShow moreCiteAdd to MendeleyShare10.1016/j.jacceco.2026.101933Access through your organizationPurchase PDFMore actionsArticle previewIntroductionSection snippetsReferences (26)First page previewClick to open first page previewView PDFIntroductionThe paper by Kim, Kim, and Rajgopal (2026) examines the effects of the SEC (2022) amendments to Rule 10b5-1 on opportunistic insider trading. Adopted in 2000, Rule 10b5-1 created an affirmative defense that allows corporate insiders to trade pursuant to a pre-established trading plan, even if they later come into possession of material nonpublic information, provided the plan was adopted in good faith before the insider became aware of that information (SEC, 1999). By providing greater legal certainty regarding the circumstances under which insiders may rely on Rule 10b5-1 plans, the rule seeks to facilitate legitimate liquidity and diversification while preserving the prohibition on trading based on material nonpublic information.Over time, however, regulators, academics, and investors raised concerns that insiders exploited perceived weaknesses in the rule by adopting plans shortly before anticipated disclosures, terminating plans opportunistically, or otherwise using Rule 10b5-1 plans in ways that undermined the purpose of the affirmative defense. In response, the SEC adopted a series of amendments in 2022, including mandatory cooling-off periods, enhanced disclosure requirements, restrictions on overlapping plans, and new certifications intended to reduce opportunistic trading while preserving the legitimate use of trading plans (SEC, 2022).Kim, Kim, and Rajgopal (2026) provide compelling evidence that these amendments altered insider trading behavior. The paper's strongest evidence concerns the new cooling-off-period requirements, documenting a substantial reduction in short-lag trades and a reduction in the ability of Rule 10b5-1 sales to predict subsequent stock-price declines. The paper also documents important changes associated with several ancillary provisions, including accelerated disclosure of stock gifts and new disclosure requirements surrounding plan terminations. Collectively, the evidence suggests that the amendments were successful in reducing opportunistic trading behavior.The paper's research design is well suited to identifying whether opportunistic trading declined following the 2022 amendments. However, it leaves open an important question regarding the mechanism underlying these changes. The authors interpret their findings primarily as evidence that the amendments worked by directly constraining insiders' ability to trade on material nonpublic information. As we discuss, the evidence is also consistent with a broader institutional response. During this same period, regulators, practitioners, and enforcement developments encouraged many firms to revisit their insider trading policies and compliance programs. Because these internal governance mechanisms often impose trading restrictions that extend beyond the legal requirements of Rule 10b5-1, they provide an additional channel through which the amendments may have influenced insider trading behavior.Distinguishing among these mechanisms is important for both research and policy. If the observed effects arise primarily from the amended rule itself, the findings support greater reliance on ex ante trading constraints. If, instead, the amendments operated in part by inducing firms to strengthen their compliance programs and governance practices, the results underscore the importance of private ordering in implementing securities regulation. More broadly, understanding how legal reforms interact with firms’ internal governance systems may improve both the interpretation of empirical evidence and the design of future securities regulation.Our discussion proceeds as follows. Section 2 explains that the 2022 amendments should not be viewed as a discrete legal intervention. Rather, they were implemented through firms’ compliance programs, which were evolving both before and after the amendments in response to regulatory signals, enforcement developments, practitioner guidance, and changing legal risk. Section 3 then considers whether the evidence presented by Kim, Kim, and Rajgopal (2026) distinguishes between the direct legal effects of the amendments and these broader organizational responses. Section 4 concludes.Organizational accessGet full-text access by signing in with your organisationAccess through your organizationOther access optionsPurchase PDFNeed help with access?Section snippetsCorporate compliance and the implementation of insider trading lawThe central question raised by Kim, Kim, and Rajgopal's (2026) findings is whether the 2022 amendments reduced opportunistic insider trading solely by imposing new legal constraints or also by inducing firms to strengthen their internal compliance systems. source_records.title: The role of executives in foreign tax planning
source_records.abstract: This study investigates the importance of top executives for foreign tax planning in multinational corporations. Applying incremental R2 comparisons and Shapley Value decompositions, we find that executives account for meaningful variation in foreign tax planning and the number of foreign (tax haven) subsidiaries, but have limited influence on effective tax rates in nonhaven affiliates. We further provide initial evidence that executive influence declined following the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act of 2017 (TCJA), with the decrease being less pronounced for foreign effective tax rates than for domestic ones. Overall, our findings highlight how managers' influence varies with their firms’ internal structures and external policy changes. Our results contribute to the literature on executive effects, multinational tax planning, and the behavioral implications of tax policy reforms.

before.title_zh: 高管在外国税收筹划中的作用
before.abstract_zh: 本研究考察了高管对跨国公司外国税收筹划的重要性。通过应用增量R2比较和Shapley值分解，我们发现高管对外国税收筹划和外国（避税天堂）子公司数量具有显著影响，但对非避税天堂关联公司的有效税率影响有限。我们进一步提供了初步证据，表明高管影响力在2017年《减税与就业法案》（TCJA）之后有所下降，其中外国有效税率的下降幅度不如国内有效税率明显。总体而言，我们的发现凸显了管理者的影响力如何随公司内部结构和外部政策变化而变化。我们的结果对高管效应、跨国税收筹划以及税收政策改革的行为影响等文献有所贡献。

decisions.title: An examination of direct and spillover effects of accounting standards on firms’ information environments

source_records.title: An examination of direct and spillover effects of accounting standards on firms’ information environments
source_records.abstract: A growing literature suggests that accounting standards not only affect public information but also improve the information environment within a firm, leading to operational changes. In this paper, we examine one mechanism for the informational improvements brought by accounting standards. We present a model that demonstrates myopic incentives driven by short-term price pressure can endogenously lead to underinvestment in information. However, imposing an accounting standard that mandates a minimum level of information quality increases acquisition of decision-relevant information for activities the standard targets and untargeted but related activities. The resulting improvements in reporting quality accentuate investors' reliance on the accounting report, which incentivizes the manager to put forth more effort. Collectively, the improvements in information quality and increase in effort improve the firm's subsequent profitability. Using archival data in the context of the revenue recognition standard (ASC 606), we find evidence consistent with the primary conclusions of the modeled environment.

before.title_zh: 会计准则对企业信息环境的直接效应与溢出效应考察
before.abstract_zh: 越来越多的文献表明，会计准则不仅影响公开信息，还改善企业内部的信息环境，从而导致运营变化。在本文中，我们考察会计准则所带来的信息改善的一种机制。我们提出一个模型，证明由短期价格压力驱动的短视激励可以内生地导致信息投资不足。然而，实施一项要求最低信息质量水平的会计准则，会增加对准则所针对活动以及未针对但相关活动的决策相关信息获取。由此带来的报告质量改善凸显了投资者对会计报告的依赖，从而激励管理者付出更多努力。总体而言，信息质量的改善和努力的增加提高了企业随后的盈利能力。利用收入确认准则（ASC 606）背景下的档案数据，我们发现了与模型环境主要结论一致的证据。

The resulting improvements in reporting quality accentuate investors' reliance on the accounting report, which incentivizes the manager to put forth more effort. Collectively, the improvements in information quality and increase in effort improve the firm's subsequent profitability. Using archival data in the context of the revenue recognition standard (ASC 606), we find evidence consistent with the primary conclusions of the modeled environment.

source_records.title: Do financial disclosures affect corporate sustainability practices?
source_records.abstract: We examine whether financial disclosures affect firm sustainability practices. Using mandatory segment reporting in the United States as the setting, we find that disclosing financial information about previously hidden segments in polluting industries reduces toxic emissions from firm plants. This effect is consistent with the notion that segment disclosures enhance monitoring of firm pollution by highlighting the financial materiality of polluting segments and drawing stakeholders’ attention to their environmental impact. The effect is stronger when the newly disclosed segments are more polluting. Disclosing firms achieve this reduction by implementing better pollution prevention practices, reducing waste generation, and increasing green innovation. Overall, our study highlights the role of mandatory financial disclosures in shaping corporate practices beyond the scope of the disclosed information.

before.title_zh: 财务披露是否影响企业可持续发展实践？
before.abstract_zh: 我们考察财务披露是否影响企业可持续发展实践。以美国的强制性分部报告为研究背景，我们发现，披露此前隐藏的污染行业分部的财务信息会减少企业工厂的有毒排放。这一效应与以下观点一致：分部披露通过凸显污染分部的财务重要性并吸引利益相关者对其环境影响的关注，增强了对企业污染的监督。当新披露的分部污染程度更高时，该效应更强。披露企业通过实施更好的污染预防实践、减少废物产生以及增加绿色创新来实现这一减排。总体而言，我们的研究凸显了强制性财务披露在塑造企业实践方面超出所披露信息范围的作用。

decisions.title: The role of federal agency accounting quality in federal budget allocation: Evidence from audit opinions

source_records.title: The role of federal agency accounting quality in federal budget allocation: Evidence from audit opinions
source_records.abstract: This study examines the role of the accounting quality of U.S. federal agencies, measured with audit opinions, in federal budget allocations to those agencies. We find that, when an agency receives a modified audit opinion, the president proposes and Congress enacts a lower budget for the agency, and the budgetary disagreement between them increases. These effects strengthen when the president and Congress have stronger incentives to demonstrate spending accountability to taxpayers. Exploiting the enactment of the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Audit Requirement Target Act, which required the DHS to end its longstanding modified audit opinions, we find that following the act's implementation, the president proposed higher budgets for the DHS and the budgetary disagreement over the DHS diminished. These findings suggest that high-quality federal agency accounting influences budgetary decisions by reducing agencies' information asymmetry with politicians (the president and Congress) and taxpayers, facilitating the evaluation of agencies' spending accountability.

before.title_zh: 联邦机构会计质量在联邦预算分配中的作用：来自审计意见的证据
before.abstract_zh: 本研究考察美国联邦机构的会计质量（以审计意见衡量）在向这些机构分配联邦预算中的作用。我们发现，当一个机构收到非标准审计意见时，总统会为该机构提出更低的预算，国会也会颁布更低的预算，并且二者之间的预算分歧会加大。当总统和国会具有更强的动机向纳税人展示支出问责时，这些效应会增强。利用《国土安全部（DHS）审计要求目标法》的颁布——该法要求DHS结束其长期存在的非标准审计意见——我们发现，在该法实施之后，总统为DHS提出了更高的预算，并且围绕DHS的预算分歧有所减小。这些发现表明，高质量的联邦机构会计通过减少机构与政治家（总统和国会）以及纳税人之间的信息不对称，促进对机构支出问责的评估，从而影响预算决策。

existing_records.title: The role of federal agency accounting quality in federal budget allocation: Evidence from audit opinions
existing_records.abstract: This study examines the role of the accounting quality of U.S. federal agencies, measured with audit opinions, in federal budget allocations to those agencies. We find that, when an agency receives a modified audit opinion, the president proposes and Congress enacts a lower budget for the agency, and the budgetary disagreement between them increases. These effects strengthen when the president and Congress have stronger incentives to demonstrate spending accountability to taxpayers. Exploiting the enactment of the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Audit Requirement Target Act, which required the DHS to end its longstanding modified audit opinions, we find that following the act's implementation, the president proposed higher budgets for the DHS and the budgetary disagreement over the DHS diminished. These findings suggest that high-quality federal agency accounting influences budgetary decisions by reducing agencies' information asymmetry with politicians (the president and Congress) and taxpayers, facilitating the evaluation of agencies' spending accountability.

decisions.title: Pay for(eign) performance: CEO pay incentives for foreign tax savings

source_records.title: Pay for(eign) performance: CEO pay incentives for foreign tax savings
source_records.abstract: This paper investigates the relation between executive compensation and corporate tax policies, with a focus on the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act of 2017 (TCJA). Using a pay-performance sensitivity framework, we analyze the differing compensation rewards associated with domestic and foreign pre-tax incomes. Our findings reveal that, before the TCJA, executives received significantly higher rewards for foreign income, encouraging them to shift income abroad. The TCJA reduced this disparity, bringing rewards for domestic and foreign income into closer alignment. A cross-sectional analysis shows that firms assessing CEO performance based on after-tax income exhibit greater sensitivity to changes in tax policy, establishing the presence of a tax mechanism. Additional tests eliminate alternative nontax explanations related to protectionist trade policies and changes in foreign market growth opportunities. These results highlight the significant impact of executive incentives on corporate tax behavior and the effectiveness of tax policy reforms.

before.title_zh: 为（外国）业绩付酬：CEO薪酬激励与外国税收节省
before.abstract_zh: 本文研究高管薪酬与企业税收政策之间的关系，重点关注2017年的《减税与就业法案》（TCJA）。我们采用薪酬-业绩敏感性框架，分析国内与国外税前收入所对应的不同薪酬回报。我们的研究发现，在TCJA之前，高管因国外收入获得显著更高的回报，这促使他们将收入转移至海外。TCJA缩小了这一差距，使国内和国外收入的回报趋于一致。横截面分析表明，以税后收入评估CEO业绩的企业对税收政策变化表现出更大的敏感性，从而确立了税收机制的存在。额外的检验排除了与保护主义贸易政策和外国市场增长机会变化相关的其他非税解释。这些结果凸显了高管激励对企业税收行为的显著影响以及税收政策改革的有效性。

decisions.title: Whispering progress: Fear of automation and voluntary disclosure

source_records.title: Whispering progress: Fear of automation and voluntary disclosure
source_records.abstract: We examine how employee fears of automation-driven job displacement influence corporate disclosure of automation plans. Using a novel measure of local automation fear constructed from cable news transcripts, we document a robust negative relation between automation fear and firms’ propensity to provide forward-looking disclosure about automation strategies. This effect strengthens when disclosure conveys incremental information, when automation substitutes for labor, and when firms face greater union exposure or political costs. To strengthen identification, we exploit quasi-natural experiments that induce increases in automation fear, expected union resistance, and political costs, respectively. We also find suggestive evidence that firms increase private communication with investors to compensate for the reduction in public information provision. Overall, our findings shed light on the trade-offs between maintaining transparency and mitigating adverse employee and politician responses in the era of rapid technological advancement.

before.title_zh: 低语中的进步：对自动化的恐惧与自愿披露
before.abstract_zh: 我们考察员工对自动化驱动的工作岗位流失的恐惧如何影响企业对自动化计划的披露。使用一种基于有线新闻文字记录构建的本地自动化恐惧的新颖度量，我们记录了自动化恐惧与企业提供关于自动化战略的前瞻性披露倾向之间存在稳健的负相关关系。当披露传递增量信息、当自动化替代劳动力、以及当企业面临更大的工会敞口或政治成本时，这一效应会增强。为加强识别，我们分别利用引发自动化恐惧上升、预期工会抵制上升和政治成本上升的准自然实验。我们还发现提示性证据表明，企业会增加与投资者的私人沟通，以弥补公共信息提供的减少。总体而言，我们的发现揭示了在技术快速进步的时代，在保持透明度与缓解员工和政客不利反应之间的权衡。

existing_records.title: Whispering progress: Fear of automation and voluntary disclosure
existing_records.abstract: We examine how employee fears of automation-driven job displacement influence corporate disclosure of automation plans. Using a novel measure of local automation fear constructed from cable news transcripts, we document a robust negative relation between automation fear and firms’ propensity to provide forward-looking disclosure about automation strategies. This effect strengthens when disclosure conveys incremental information, when automation substitutes for labor, and when firms face greater union exposure or political costs. To strengthen identification, we exploit quasi-natural experiments that induce increases in automation fear, expected union resistance, and political costs, respectively. We also find suggestive evidence that firms increase private communication with investors to compensate for the reduction in public information provision. Overall, our findings shed light on the trade-offs between maintaining transparency and mitigating adverse employee and politician responses in the era of rapid technological advancement.

decisions.title: Re-doing the audit

source_records.title: Re-doing the audit
source_records.abstract: This study investigates the practice of re-audits—where an incoming audit firm re-audits the prior year's financial statements previously examined by a predecessor audit firm. We examine the costs and benefits of such re-audits. We find that re-audits are more likely when the risks of misstatement are high and when incoming auditors can expect to win more clients by identifying material misstatements overlooked by predecessor auditors. Our results show that incoming auditors who perform re-audits are more successful in winning new clients from predecessor auditors. Moreover, re-audits result in significantly more restatements. However, consistent with the resource-intensive nature of re-audits, we also find that they are associated with longer audit delays and higher audit fees. Overall, we conclude that re-audits have important consequences for financial statement users, incoming auditors, and predecessor auditors.

before.title_zh: 重新进行审计
before.abstract_zh: 本研究考察了重新审计这一做法——即新进入的审计事务所对前任审计事务所此前已审查过的上一年度财务报表进行重新审计。我们考察了此类重新审计的成本与收益。我们发现，当错报风险较高，且新进入的审计师预期能够通过识别前任审计师忽视的重大错报而赢得更多客户时，重新审计更有可能发生。我们的结果表明，执行重新审计的新进入审计师更能够成功地从前任审计师手中赢得新客户。此外，重新审计导致显著更多的重述。然而，与重新审计资源密集的性质相一致，我们还发现重新审计与更长的审计延迟和更高的审计费用相关。总体而言，我们得出结论：重新审计对财务报表使用者、新进入审计师和前任审计师都具有重要后果。

decisions.title: Managers’ understanding of macroeconomic news, competitor influence, and firm performance: Evidence from consumer sentiment news

source_records.title: Managers’ understanding of macroeconomic news, competitor influence, and firm performance: Evidence from consumer sentiment news
source_records.abstract: This paper examines the association between managers' failure to incorporate macroeconomic news and firm performance, focusing on the role of competitors. Measuring this failure using the extent to which management revenue forecast errors reflect U.S. consumer sentiment, we find an asymmetric association. When firms underestimate consumer demand and underproduce, failing to incorporate consumer sentiment news is associated with worse performance, but when they overestimate demand and overproduce, no association exists. These results are consistent with competitors reacting differently to underproduction and overproduction, worsening firm performance in the case of underproduction but not necessarily in overproduction. Cross-sectional analyses reveal that the negative association is mainly present when U.S. consumer sentiment is important and strategic interactions are stronger, such as in markets with higher product similarity. Overall, our findings suggest that the performance consequences of forecast errors due to failure to understand macroeconomic information are nuanced and depend on competitors’ strategic actions.

before.title_zh: 管理者对宏观经济新闻的理解、竞争者影响与企业绩效：来自消费者情绪新闻的证据
before.abstract_zh: 本文考察管理者未能纳入宏观经济新闻与企业绩效之间的关联，重点关注竞争者的作用。我们使用管理层收入预测误差反映美国消费者情绪的程度来衡量这种未能纳入，发现存在非对称关联。当企业低估消费者需求并生产不足时，未能纳入消费者情绪新闻与更差的绩效相关；但当企业高估需求并生产过剩时，不存在这种关联。这些结果与竞争者对生产不足和生产过剩作出不同反应相一致：在生产不足的情况下企业绩效恶化，但在生产过剩的情况下未必如此。横截面分析表明，这种负向关联主要存在于美国消费者情绪重要且战略互动更强的情形中，例如产品相似度更高的市场。总体而言，我们的发现表明，因未能理解宏观经济信息而产生的预测误差，其绩效后果是微妙的，并取决于竞争者的战略行动。

after.title_zh: 管理者对宏观经济新闻的理解、竞争者影响与企业绩效：来自消费者情绪新闻的证据
after.abstract_zh: 本文考察管理者未能纳入宏观经济新闻与企业绩效之间的关联，重点关注竞争者的作用。我们使用管理层收入预测误差反映美国消费者情绪的程度来衡量这种未能纳入，发现存在非对称关联。当企业低估消费者需求并生产不足时，未能纳入消费者情绪新闻与更差的绩效相关；但当企业高估需求并生产过剩时，不存在这种关联。这些结果与竞争者对生产不足和生产过剩作出不同反应相一致：在生产不足的情况下企业绩效恶化，但在生产过剩的情况下未必如此。横截面分析表明，这种负向关联主要存在于美国消费者情绪重要且战略互动更强的情形中，例如产品相似度更高的市场。总体而言，我们的发现表明，因未能理解宏观经济信息而产生的预测误差，其绩效后果是微妙的，并取决于竞争者的战略行动。

decisions.title: Tracing investors' minds: Investors’ inquiries and key audit matter reporting

source_records.title: Tracing investors' minds: Investors’ inquiries and key audit matter reporting
source_records.abstract: This study investigates whether auditors incorporate investor information demand when determining key audit matter (KAM) disclosures. We measure investor information demand using a unique dataset of investor inquiries submitted through investor interactive platforms (IIPs) established by China's major stock exchanges. At the topic level, we find that auditors are more likely to disclose a given topic as a KAM when investors raise more inquiries on that topic. At the aggregate level, a higher proportion of inquiries devoted to accounting issues is associated with both a greater number of KAMs and longer KAM disclosures. Importantly, following the introduction of KAM reporting, managers' footnote disclosures become more aligned with heightened investor inquiries, reinforcing our interpretation that the documented effects reflect auditors’ responses to investor inquiries rather than merely mirroring managerial disclosure changes. Overall, our findings suggest that auditors incorporate investor information demand into KAM disclosures.

before.title_zh: 追踪投资者的思维：投资者问询与关键审计事项报告
before.abstract_zh: 本研究考察审计师在确定关键审计事项（KAM）披露时是否纳入了投资者的信息需求。我们使用通过中国主要证券交易所建立的投资者互动平台（IIP）提交的投资者问询这一独特数据集来衡量投资者的信息需求。在主题层面，我们发现当投资者对某一主题提出更多问询时，审计师更可能将该主题披露为一项KAM。在总体层面，用于会计问题的问询比例越高，与KAM数量越多以及KAM披露篇幅越长相关。重要的是，在引入KAM报告之后，管理层的附注披露与投资者问询的增加变得更加一致，这强化了我们的解释，即所记录的影响反映的是审计师对投资者问询的回应，而不仅仅是管理层披露变化的镜像。总体而言，我们的发现表明审计师将投资者的信息需求纳入了KAM披露。

decisions.title: Generative AI and investor processing of financial information

source_records.title: Generative AI and investor processing of financial information
source_records.abstract: This paper provides archival and survey evidence on retail investor use of Generative AI (GenAI). Our archival analysis examines over 400,000 investor queries to a major brokerage's GenAI chatbot. Investors most often use GenAI to help interpret and contextualize financial information and market movements, and for additional tasks including stock screening and streamlining complex research. As time with the tool grows, usage shifts from stock screening and high-level company assessments toward detailed monitoring and interpretation of firm news. Our survey of over 2,000 retail investors explores who adopts GenAI and why. Nearly half report using GenAI, primarily to accelerate and simplify information processing. More sophisticated retail investors lead adoption, deploying GenAI for more complex tasks and diverse information sources. Concerns about response quality and data privacy represent the biggest obstacles to further adoption. Heterogeneous adoption highlights the need for research into GenAI's impact on investor behavior and market dynamics.

before.title_zh: 生成式AI与投资者对财务信息的处理
before.abstract_zh: 本文提供了关于散户投资者使用生成式AI（GenAI）的档案证据和调查证据。我们的档案分析考察了某大型券商GenAI聊天机器人收到的超过400,000条投资者查询。投资者最常使用GenAI来帮助解读财务信息和市场走势并为其提供背景，以及用于其他任务，包括股票筛选和简化复杂研究。随着使用该工具时间的增加，使用方式从股票筛选和高层次的公司评估转向对公司新闻的详细监测和解读。我们对超过2,000名散户投资者的调查探讨了谁会采用GenAI以及原因。近一半报告使用GenAI，主要是为了加速和简化信息处理。更成熟的散户投资者引领采用，将GenAI用于更复杂的任务和多样化的信息来源。对回答质量和数据隐私的担忧是进一步采用的最大障碍。异质性采用凸显了研究GenAI对投资者行为和市场动态影响的必要性。

decisions.title: Ideology-driven social media opinions and capital markets: Evidence from polarizing boycotts

source_records.title: Ideology-driven social media opinions and capital markets: Evidence from polarizing boycotts
source_records.abstract: Investors increasingly turn to social media for information, even though many sites are saturated with ideological opinions. This paper examines whether ideology-driven social media opinions affect stock market responses to polarizing firm news, using boycotts as the empirical setting. On average, polarizing boycotts are associated with a 1% (2.3%) drop in equity value over the seven (60) trading days after gaining social media traction. Consistent with ideology-driven opinions affecting market responses, the immediate price reaction is more negative when users ideologically aligned with boycotters dominate social media, particularly when their opinions are visible and financially relevant. A mediation analysis suggests that this association operates indirectly through overall social media sentiment toward the boycotted firms. Additionally, trading volume and daily return volatility following boycotts are positively associated with user ideological diversity. Together, these results suggest that ideology-driven social media opinions could influence how investors respond to polarizing firm news.

before.title_zh: 意识形态驱动的社交媒体观点与资本市场：来自极化抵制的证据
before.abstract_zh: 投资者越来越多地转向社交媒体获取信息，尽管许多网站充斥着意识形态观点。本文以抵制活动作为实证场景，考察意识形态驱动的社交媒体观点是否会影响股票市场对极化企业新闻的反应。平均而言，在获得社交媒体关注后的七（60）个交易日内，极化抵制与股权价值下降1%（2.3%）相关。与意识形态驱动的观点影响市场反应相一致，当与抵制者意识形态一致的用户在社交媒体上占主导地位时，尤其是当其观点可见且具有财务相关性时，即时价格反应更为负面。中介分析表明，这种关联通过社交媒体对被抵制企业的整体情绪间接发挥作用。此外，抵制活动后的交易量和日收益率波动与用户意识形态多样性正相关。总之，这些结果表明，意识形态驱动的社交媒体观点可能影响投资者对极化企业新闻的反应。

decisions.title: The effects of tax clienteles on disclosure: Evidence from the municipal bond market

source_records.title: The effects of tax clienteles on disclosure: Evidence from the municipal bond market
source_records.abstract: The municipal bond market has long been criticized for its lack of disclosure, which prior research often attributes to weak regulatory oversight. We offer another explanation: tax clienteles. Most municipal bonds are tax-exempt, and thus primarily attract high-tax retail investors, who may lack the incentive or ability to demand or monitor disclosures. In contrast, taxable bonds attract a broader investor base, including institutional investors who can demand disclosure. We find that issuers provide more continuing disclosures in years with taxable bonds outstanding relative to years without. Issuers also increase disclosures after issuing their first taxable bond and decrease disclosures after calling their last taxable bond. Exploiting a tax law change, we find that disclosures increase following plausibly exogenous increases in taxable bond issuances. Our results suggest that the tax clienteles for municipal bonds affect issuers’ disclosure practices and can inform those concerned with disclosure noncompliance in the municipal bond market.

decisions.title: Technological investment and accounting: A demand-side perspective on labor markets and enrollments

source_records.title: Technological investment and accounting: A demand-side perspective on labor markets and enrollments
source_records.abstract: Since 2011, there has been a substantial decline in the number of students graduating from college with accounting majors. We help explain this decline by empirically showing that technological advancement is associated with lower relative demand from employers for accounting majors compared to other business majors, especially finance. Specifically, corporate software investment is associated with lower relative wages and employment for accounting majors. Cross-sectional tests point to these findings resulting from differences in demand for human capital associated with specific college majors. As the wage gap between finance and accounting majors widens, fewer students subsequently choose an accounting major and more choose a finance major, consistent with selection models going back to Roy (1951). Our findings illustrate the utility of incorporating human capital demand factors into analyses of accounting labor markets and their connection to college major choice.

before.title_zh: 技术投资与会计：从需求侧视角看劳动力市场与专业选择
before.abstract_zh: 自2011年以来，以会计为主修专业毕业的大学生人数大幅下降。我们通过实证表明，与其他商科专业（尤其是金融）相比，技术进步与雇主对会计专业毕业生的相对需求下降相关，从而有助于解释这一下降。具体而言，企业软件投资与会计专业毕业生相对工资和就业的下降相关。横截面检验表明，这些发现源于与特定大学主修专业相关的人力资本需求差异。随着金融与会计专业之间的工资差距扩大，随后选择会计专业的学生减少，选择金融专业的学生增多，这与可追溯至Roy（1951）的选择模型一致。我们的发现说明了将人力资本需求因素纳入会计劳动力市场分析及其与大学专业选择之间联系的有用性。

source_records.title: Direct and Indirect Effects of Transparency Regulation
source_records.raw_title: Direct and Indirect Effects of Transparency Regulation

source_records.title: Direct and Indirect Effects of Transparency Regulation
source_records.abstract: We examine the direct and indirect effects of transparency regulation on economic activity. Using two distinct sources of regulatory variation—the varying extent of financial-reporting requirements and the staggered introduction of electronic business registers in Europe—, we find that direct exposure to transparency regulation tends to hurt focal firms’ economic activity (e.g., production and employment). By contrast, we find that indirect exposure to transparency regulation imposed on other related firms tends to help focal firms’ economic activity. In terms of relative magnitudes, we find that the negative direct and positive indirect effects tend to be of similar size, almost perfectly offsetting each other. Collectively, our evidence suggests that transparency regulation appears to primarily reallocate economic activity from more toward less regulated markets rather than help or hurt aggregate economic activity.

before.title_zh: 透明度监管的直接效应与间接效应
before.abstract_zh: 我们考察透明度监管对经济活动的直接效应与间接效应。利用两种不同的监管变异来源——财务报告要求的程度差异以及欧洲电子企业登记册的分阶段引入——，我们发现，直接暴露于透明度监管往往会损害焦点企业的经济活动（例如生产和就业）。相比之下，我们发现，由施加于其他关联企业的透明度监管所带来的间接暴露，往往有助于焦点企业的经济活动。就相对幅度而言，我们发现负向直接效应与正向间接效应往往规模相近，几乎完全相互抵消。总体而言，我们的证据表明，透明度监管似乎主要是将经济活动从监管较多的市场重新配置到监管较少的市场，而非帮助或损害总体经济活动。

source_records.abstract: We examine the direct and indirect effects of transparency regulation on economic activity. Using two distinct sources of regulatory variation—the varying extent of financial-reporting requirements and the staggered introduction of electronic business registers in Europe—, we find that direct exposure to transparency regulation tends to hurt focal firms’ economic activity (e.g., production and employment). By contrast, we find that indirect exposure to transparency regulation imposed on other related firms tends to help focal firms’ economic activity. In terms of relative magnitudes, we find that the negative direct and positive indirect effects tend to be of similar size, almost perfectly offsetting each other. Collectively, our evidence suggests that transparency regulation appears to primarily reallocate economic activity from more toward less regulated markets rather than help or hurt aggregate economic activity.

after.title_zh: 透明度监管的直接效应与间接效应
after.abstract_zh: 我们考察透明度监管对经济活动的直接效应与间接效应。利用两种不同的监管变异来源——财务报告要求的程度差异以及欧洲电子企业登记册的分阶段引入——，我们发现，直接暴露于透明度监管往往会损害焦点企业的经济活动（例如生产和就业）。相比之下，我们发现，由施加于其他关联企业的透明度监管所带来的间接暴露，往往有助于焦点企业的经济活动。就相对幅度而言，我们发现负向直接效应与正向间接效应往往规模相近，几乎完全相互抵消。总体而言，我们的证据表明，透明度监管似乎主要是将经济活动从监管较多的市场重新配置到监管较少的市场，而非帮助或损害总体经济活动。

source_records.title: Navigating new accounting standards: Implications for firms and their auditors
source_records.abstract: I examine the consequences of implementing new accounting standards on financial reporting quality. While prior research suggests that standards generally achieve their regulatory objectives, recent literature identifies firms’ significant technical accounting capacity constraints, motivating the need to explore the broader consequences of accounting standards adoption on financial reporting quality. Using a novel AI-based approach to identify firms affected by new accounting standards, I find a decrease in financial reporting quality when firms implement new standards. Evidence suggests the impaired financial reporting quality is in accounting areas unrelated to the new standards, consistent with a distraction effect. Results are more pronounced when firms face other concurrent accounting-related challenges, when accounting standards are more complex, and when auditors have resource constraints. These findings provide evidence of the unintended consequences of new accounting standards and shed light on potential ways to mitigate these costs.

before.title_zh: 应对新会计准则：对企业及其审计师的影响
before.abstract_zh: 我考察了实施新会计准则对财务报告质量的影响。尽管先前研究表明准则总体上实现了其监管目标，但近期文献发现企业面临显著的技术会计能力约束，这促使我们需要探究会计准则采用对财务报告质量更广泛的影响。我采用一种新颖的基于人工智能的方法来识别受新会计准则影响的企业，发现当企业实施新准则时，财务报告质量下降。证据表明，受损的财务报告质量出现在与新准则无关的会计领域，这与分心效应一致。当企业同时面临其他与会计相关的挑战、会计准则更为复杂以及审计师资源受限时，结果更为显著。这些发现为新会计准则的意外后果提供了证据，并为缓解这些成本的潜在途径提供了启示。

source_records.title: Measurement error when estimating covenant slack and violations
source_records.abstract: We collect quantitative (true thresholds and realizations) and qualitative (compliance status) covenant information from SEC filings to examine the accuracy of compliance estimates derived using data from commercial databases. Estimated covenant slack frequently overestimates covenant violations, and only rarely understates them, with this asymmetry holding for both qualitative and quantitative disclosers. The non-random structure of this measurement error has implications for research that relies on estimated violations or on precise measurement of covenant realizations near a threshold. Across our two samples of disclosers, we find evidence consistent with the debt covenant hypothesis for debt-to-EBITDA covenants once measurement error is considered. We also show that the lender forbearance rate declines sharply after correcting estimated violations for measurement error, and that true violations, but not estimated violations, are associated with negative stock market reactions and loan renegotiations. Finally, we investigate practical approaches to reduce measurement error.

before.title_zh: 估计契约松弛与违约时的测量误差
before.abstract_zh: 我们从SEC文件中收集定量的（真实阈值和实现值）和定性的（合规状态）契约信息，以检验使用商业数据库数据得出的合规估计的准确性。估计的契约松弛经常高估契约违约，而很少低估违约，这种不对称性在定性披露者和定量披露者中都成立。这种测量误差的非随机结构对依赖估计违约或依赖对阈值附近契约实现值进行精确测量的研究具有启示意义。在我们的两个披露者样本中，一旦考虑测量误差，我们发现与债务契约假说一致的证据，针对债务与EBITDA契约。我们还表明，在将估计违约针对测量误差进行校正后，贷款人宽限率急剧下降，并且真实违约——而非估计违约——与负面的股票市场反应和贷款重新谈判相关。最后，我们探讨减少测量误差的实用方法。

source_records.title: Regulating via social media: Deterrence effects of the SEC's use of Twitter
source_records.abstract: This paper presents the ﬁrst evidence of the eﬀect of ﬁnancial regulators’ social media use on corporate and individual behavior. Using the staggered launch of U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) regional oﬃces’ Twitter accounts, I ﬁnd that ﬁnancial regulators’ presence on social media reduces opportunistic insider trading, customer complaints against investment advisers, and ﬁnancial misrepor ting. Additional tests suggest that the salience and dissemination of regional oﬃces’ enforcement activities via Twitter play a role. The deterrence eﬀect of SEC regional oﬃces’ Twitter use is concentrated among oﬃces with more followers, ﬁrms with more retail investors, and advisers with more retail clients. I also show that investors react more strongly to enforcement actions after the enforced ﬁrm’s regional oﬃce initiates Twitter use. Taken together, the results suggest that ﬁnancial regulators’ use of social media helps deter misconduct. Lin

before.title_zh: 通过社交媒体进行监管：美国证券交易委员会使用Twitter的威慑效应
before.abstract_zh: 本文首次提供了金融监管机构使用社交媒体对公司和个人行为影响的证据。利用美国证券交易委员会（SEC）各地区办公室Twitter账户的分批推出，我发现金融监管机构在社交媒体上的存在减少了机会主义内幕交易、针对投资顾问的客户投诉以及财务错报。额外测试表明，地区办公室通过Twitter发布执法活动的显著性和传播发挥了作用。SEC地区办公室使用Twitter的威慑效应集中在拥有更多关注者的办公室、拥有更多散户投资者的公司以及拥有更多散户客户的投资顾问中。我还表明，在被执法公司的地区办公室开始使用Twitter后，投资者对执法行动的反应更强烈。总体而言，结果表明金融监管机构使用社交媒体有助于遏制不当行为。Lin

after.title_zh: 通过社交媒体进行监管：美国证券交易委员会使用Twitter的威慑效应
after.abstract_zh: 本文首次提供了金融监管机构使用社交媒体对公司和个人行为影响的证据。利用美国证券交易委员会（SEC）各地区办公室Twitter账户的分批推出，我发现金融监管机构在社交媒体上的存在减少了机会主义内幕交易、针对投资顾问的客户投诉以及财务错报。额外测试表明，地区办公室通过Twitter发布执法活动的显著性和传播发挥了作用。SEC地区办公室使用Twitter的威慑效应集中在拥有更多关注者的办公室、拥有更多散户投资者的公司以及拥有更多散户客户的投资顾问中。我还表明，在被执法公司的地区办公室开始使用Twitter后，投资者对执法行动的反应更强烈。总体而言，结果表明金融监管机构使用社交媒体有助于遏制不当行为。Lin

source_records.abstract: Bhojraj et al. (2026) provide novel evidence that systemically large banks' internal loan loss forecasts systematically overreact to new information and that this overreaction is economically meaningful for loan loss provisioning. Our discussion focuses on whether the evidence identifies representativeness bias, as opposed to a broader set of behavioral, institutional, and economic mechanisms. We argue that the paper more convincingly documents overreaction than it isolates representativeness as the underlying mechanism. We revisit the role of bank information environment, data generating process, COVID-era uncertainty, endogenous bank responses, regulatory influences, and the interpretation of the CECL (Current Expected Credit Losses) results relative to subsidiaries of IFRS 9 adopters. While several additional analyses are supportive of biased expectations, others suggest a more cautious reading of the mechanism. Our overall takeaway is that the paper's central contribution would be strengthened by framing the evidence more directly around overreaction in bank expectations formation and its implications for provisioning, while leaving greater room for multiple coexisting mechanisms and future research on how behavioral forces enter bank forecasting environments.

before.title_zh: 是什么驱动了银行对贷款损失信息的过度反应？对贷款损失预测中不完美预期的讨论
before.abstract_zh: Bhojraj等（2026）提供了新颖的证据，表明系统重要性大型银行的内部贷款损失预测会系统性地对新信息过度反应，且这种过度反应对贷款损失拨备具有经济意义上的重要性。我们的讨论聚焦于这些证据是否识别出了代表性偏差，而非更广泛的行为、制度与经济机制。我们认为，该文更令人信服地记录了过度反应，而非将代表性孤立为 underlying mechanism。我们重新审视了银行信息环境的作用、数据生成过程、COVID时期的不确定性、内生性银行反应、监管影响，以及CECL（当前预期信用损失）结果相对于IFRS 9采用者子公司的解释。尽管若干额外分析支持有偏预期，但另一些分析则提示对机制的解读应更为谨慎。我们的总体看法是，若将证据更直接地围绕银行预期形成中的过度反应及其对拨备的含义来构建，同时为多种共存机制以及关于行为力量如何进入银行预测环境的未来研究留出更大空间，该文的核心贡献将得到加强。

existing_records.title: Imperfect expectations in loan loss forecasts
existing_records.abstract: Forecasts of future realized loan losses that deviate from rational expectations can impact banks' loan loss provisions, lending procyclicality, and financial stability, especially under the forward-looking current expected credit losses (CECL) model. The behavioral finance literature suggests that bank forecasts are influenced by the representativeness heuristic, which posits that, in forming estimates of future events, forecasters overreact to current circumstances. Leveraging confidential supervisory data from FR Y-14A filings, we document the presence of such overreaction in banks' forecasts of net loan charge-offs. We find that revisions of these forecasts (current forecast minus previous forecast) are negatively associated with the corresponding forecast errors (realized minus current forecast), and this pattern strengthens for longer-horizon forecasts. Successive forecasts of the same future net loan charge-offs exhibit negatively autocorrelated revisions and gradually converge to the realization, indicating the continued presence and gradual resolution of overreaction over time. The overreaction affects loan loss provision in the same direction as the forecast bias, especially for CECL adopters. This effect of overreaction under CECL is more pronounced for longer-horizon forecasts and banks with longer-maturity loans. Supporting the prevalence of this bias, we observe overreaction in banks’ forecasts across loan types and of regional macroeconomic conditions.

existing_records.abstract: Bhojraj et al. (2026) provide novel evidence that systemically large banks' internal loan loss forecasts systematically overreact to new information and that this overreaction is economically meaningful for loan loss provisioning. Our discussion focuses on whether the evidence identifies representativeness bias, as opposed to a broader set of behavioral, institutional, and economic mechanisms. We argue that the paper more convincingly documents overreaction than it isolates representativeness as the underlying mechanism. We revisit the role of bank information environment, data generating process, COVID-era uncertainty, endogenous bank responses, regulatory influences, and the interpretation of the CECL (Current Expected Credit Losses) results relative to subsidiaries of IFRS 9 adopters. While several additional analyses are supportive of biased expectations, others suggest a more cautious reading of the mechanism. Our overall takeaway is that the paper's central contribution would be strengthened by framing the evidence more directly around overreaction in bank expectations formation and its implications for provisioning, while leaving greater room for multiple coexisting mechanisms and future research on how behavioral forces enter bank forecasting environments.

after.abstract_zh: Bhojraj等（2026）提供了新颖的证据，表明系统重要性大型银行的内部贷款损失预测会系统性地对新信息过度反应，且这种过度反应对贷款损失拨备具有经济意义上的重要性。我们的讨论聚焦于这些证据是否识别出了代表性偏差，而非更广泛的行为、制度与经济机制。我们认为，该文更令人信服地记录了过度反应，而非将代表性孤立为 underlying mechanism。我们重新审视了银行信息环境的作用、数据生成过程、COVID时期的不确定性、内生性银行反应、监管影响，以及CECL（当前预期信用损失）结果相对于IFRS 9采用者子公司的解释。尽管若干额外分析支持有偏预期，但另一些分析则提示对机制的解读应更为谨慎。我们的总体看法是，若将证据更直接地围绕银行预期形成中的过度反应及其对拨备的含义来构建，同时为多种共存机制以及关于行为力量如何进入银行预测环境的未来研究留出更大空间，该文的核心贡献将得到加强。

source_records.title: A Survey of the Archival Audit Literature
source_records.abstract: External audits enhance the credibility of financial statements and are a cornerstone of capital market integrity. However, the growing and complex auditing literature poses challenges for researchers. This survey synthesizes and critically evaluates archival audit research published in top accounting journals from 1995 to 2025, organizing over 600 studies into three core areas: the audit market, audit quality, and audit personnel and processes. We offer new conceptual insights into the audit market, emphasizing that audit assurance is unobservable and that audit fee studies generally estimate reduced‐form models rather than separate demand and supply functions. On audit quality, we expand upon DeAngelo's definition to include the auditor's responsibility to assess ex ante risk. We suggest an alternative three‐dimensional definition of audit quality that is more closely aligned with professional standards. We also clarify common misconceptions arising from conflating audit quality with financial reporting quality. Finally, we review the growing literature on audit personnel and call for more research into underexplored roles of personnel in the early stages of the audit process. Our survey contributes by reframing key constructs, identifying limitations in common proxies, and suggesting future research directions to advance our understanding of how audits function and shape financial reporting outcomes.

source_records.raw_abstract:
ABSTRACT
External audits enhance the credibility of financial statements and are a cornerstone of capital market integrity. However, the growing and complex auditing literature poses challenges for researchers. This survey synthesizes and critically evaluates archival audit research published in top accounting journals from 1995 to 2025, organizing over 600 studies into three core areas: the audit market, audit quality, and audit personnel and processes. We offer new conceptual insights into the audit market, emphasizing that audit assurance is unobservable and that audit fee studies generally estimate reduced‐form models rather than separate demand and supply functions. On audit quality, we expand upon DeAngelo's definition to include the auditor's responsibility to assess ex ante risk. We suggest an alternative three‐dimensional definition of audit quality that is more closely aligned with professional standards. We also clarify common misconceptions arising from conflating audit quality with financial reporting quality. Finally, we review the growing literature on audit personnel and call for more research into underexplored roles of personnel in the early stages of the audit process. Our survey contributes by reframing key constructs, identifying limitations in common proxies, and suggesting future research directions to advance our understanding of how audits function and shape financial reporting outcomes.

RÉSUMÉ
Les audits externes renforcent la crédibilité des états financiers et constituent la pierre angulaire de l'intégrité des marchés financiers. Cependant, la littérature de plus en plus abondante et complexe sur l'audit pose des défis aux chercheurs. Cette étude synthétise et évalue de manière critique la recherche en matière d'audit fondée sur les données archivales publiée dans les principales revues de comptabilité entre 1995 et 2025, en classant plus de 600 études dans trois domaines principaux : le marché de l'audit, la qualité de l'audit, et le personnel et les processus d'audit. Nous proposons de nouvelles perspectives conceptuelles sur le marché de l'audit, en soulignant que l'assurance d'audit est non observable et que les études sur les honoraires d'audit estiment généralement des modèles réduits plutôt que des fonctions distinctes de demande et d'offre. En ce qui concerne la qualité de l'audit, nous élargissons la définition de DeAngelo pour inclure la responsabilité de l'auditeur d'évaluer le risque ex ante. Nous proposons une autre définition tridimensionnelle de la qualité de l'audit, plus conforme aux normes professionnelles. Nous clarifions également les idées fausses courantes qui découlent de la confusion entre la qualité de l'audit et la qualité de l'information financière. Enfin, nous passons en revue la littérature croissante sur le personnel d'audit et appelons à davantage de recherches sur les rôles sous‐explorés du personnel dans les premières étapes du processus d'audit. Notre étude contribue à redéfinir les concepts clés, à identifier les limites des variables représentatives courantes et à suggérer des pistes de recherche futures pour faire progresser notre compréhension du fonctionnement des audits et de leur influence sur les résultats de l'information financière.

before.title_zh: 档案审计文献综述
before.abstract_zh: 外部审计提升了财务报表的可信性，是资本市场诚信的基石。然而，不断增长且复杂的审计文献给研究者带来了挑战。本综述综合并批判性评估了1995年至2025年发表于顶级会计期刊的档案式审计研究，将600多项研究归入三个核心领域：审计市场、审计质量以及审计人员与流程。我们针对审计市场提出了新的概念性见解，强调审计保证具有不可观测性，并且审计费用研究通常估计的是简化式模型，而非分别估计需求函数与供给函数。在审计质量方面，我们扩展了DeAngelo的定义，将审计师评估事前风险的责任纳入其中。我们提出一种与职业准则更为契合的替代性三维审计质量定义。我们还澄清了因将审计质量与财务报告质量混为一谈而产生的常见误解。最后，我们回顾了关于审计人员的不断增长的文献，并呼吁对审计过程早期阶段中人员所发挥的尚未得到充分探索的作用开展更多研究。本综述的贡献在于重新构建关键构念、识别常用代理变量的局限性，并提出未来研究方向，以推进我们对审计如何运作并塑造财务报告结果的理解。

However, the growing and complex auditing literature poses challenges for researchers. This survey synthesizes and critically evaluates archival audit research published in top accounting journals from 1995 to 2025, organizing over 600 studies into three core areas: the audit market, audit quality, and audit personnel and processes. We offer new conceptual insights into the audit market, emphasizing that audit assurance is unobservable and that audit fee studies generally estimate reduced‐form models rather than separate demand and supply functions. We suggest an alternative three‐dimensional definition of audit quality that is more closely aligned with professional standards. We also clarify common misconceptions arising from conflating audit quality with financial reporting quality. Finally, we review the growing literature on audit personnel and call for more research into underexplored roles of personnel in the early stages of the audit process. Enfin, nous passons en revue la littérature croissante sur le personnel d'audit et appelons à davantage de recherches sur les rôles sous‐explorés du personnel dans les premières étapes du processus d'audit. Notre étude contribue à redéfinir les concepts clés, à identifier les limites des variables représentatives courantes et à suggérer des pistes de recherche futures pour faire progresser notre compréhension du fonctionnement des audits et de leur influence sur les résultats de l'information financière.

after.title_zh: 档案审计文献综述
after.abstract_zh: 外部审计提升了财务报表的可信性，是资本市场诚信的基石。然而，不断增长且复杂的审计文献给研究者带来了挑战。本综述综合并批判性评估了1995年至2025年发表于顶级会计期刊的档案式审计研究，将600多项研究归入三个核心领域：审计市场、审计质量以及审计人员与流程。我们针对审计市场提出了新的概念性见解，强调审计保证具有不可观测性，并且审计费用研究通常估计的是简化式模型，而非分别估计需求函数与供给函数。在审计质量方面，我们扩展了DeAngelo的定义，将审计师评估事前风险的责任纳入其中。我们提出一种与职业准则更为契合的替代性三维审计质量定义。我们还澄清了因将审计质量与财务报告质量混为一谈而产生的常见误解。最后，我们回顾了关于审计人员的不断增长的文献，并呼吁对审计过程早期阶段中人员所发挥的尚未得到充分探索的作用开展更多研究。本综述的贡献在于重新构建关键构念、识别常用代理变量的局限性，并提出未来研究方向，以推进我们对审计如何运作并塑造财务报告结果的理解。

source_records.title: Prosocial CEOs and Accounting Manipulation
source_records.abstract: This paper examines the association between CEOs' prosocial tendency and their firms' likelihood of accounting manipulation. We measure CEOs' prosocial tendency based on their involvement with charitable organizations. We find that prosocial CEOs are less likely to engage in accounting manipulation, as proxied by material non‐reliance restatements and SEC or US Department of Justice enforcement actions. The effect is more pronounced when CEOs are involved with charities that directly aim to improve the welfare of others and when they face stronger incentives to misreport. These results continue to hold in analyses of changes in CEOs' prosocial tendency around turnover events. Taken together, our findings suggest that CEOs' prosocial tendency, a fundamental personal trait, plays a significant role in shaping the quality of accounting information.

before.title_zh: 亲社会CEO与会计操纵
before.abstract_zh: 本文考察了CEO的亲社会倾向与其公司进行会计操纵的可能性之间的关联。我们基于CEO参与慈善组织的情况来衡量其亲社会倾向。我们发现，亲社会的CEO更不可能参与会计操纵，其代理变量为重大不依赖重述以及SEC或美国司法部的执法行动。当CEO参与直接旨在改善他人福利的慈善机构时，以及当他们面临更强的错报激励时，这一效应更为显著。这些结果在围绕CEO更替事件对其亲社会倾向变化的分析中依然成立。总体而言，我们的发现表明，CEO的亲社会倾向作为一种根本性的个人特质，在塑造会计信息质量方面发挥着重要作用。

Cet effet est plus accentué lorsque les PDG collaborent avec des organismes de bienfaisance visant explicitement à améliorer le bien‐être d'autrui, et lorsqu'ils sont davantage incités à faire une déclaration erronée. Ces résultats sont confirmés par les analyses des changements de tendance prosociale des PDG lors des roulements du personnel. Dans l'ensemble, les conclusions suggèrent que la tendance prosociale des PDG, en tant que trait de personnalité fondamental, joue un rôle déterminant dans la qualité de l'information comptable.

existing_records.title: Prosocial CEOs and Accounting Manipulation
existing_records.abstract: This paper examines the association between CEOs' prosocial tendency and their firms' likelihood of accounting manipulation. We measure CEOs' prosocial tendency based on their involvement with charitable organizations. We find that prosocial CEOs are less likely to engage in accounting manipulation, as proxied by material non‐reliance restatements and SEC or US Department of Justice enforcement actions. The effect is more pronounced when CEOs are involved with charities that directly aim to improve the welfare of others and when they face stronger incentives to misreport. These results continue to hold in analyses of changes in CEOs' prosocial tendency around turnover events. Taken together, our findings suggest that CEOs' prosocial tendency, a fundamental personal trait, plays a significant role in shaping the quality of accounting information.

after.title_zh: 亲社会CEO与会计操纵
after.abstract_zh: 本文考察了CEO的亲社会倾向与其公司进行会计操纵的可能性之间的关联。我们基于CEO参与慈善组织的情况来衡量其亲社会倾向。我们发现，亲社会的CEO更不可能参与会计操纵，其代理变量为重大不依赖重述以及SEC或美国司法部的执法行动。当CEO参与直接旨在改善他人福利的慈善机构时，以及当他们面临更强的错报激励时，这一效应更为显著。这些结果在围绕CEO更替事件对其亲社会倾向变化的分析中依然成立。总体而言，我们的发现表明，CEO的亲社会倾向作为一种根本性的个人特质，在塑造会计信息质量方面发挥着重要作用。

decisions.title: Tax Payments in Loss FirmsPaiements de l'impôt sur les sociétés affichant des pertes

source_records.title: Tax Payments in Loss Firms
source_records.abstract: In a broad sample of publicly traded firms, we observe that the share of firms annually reporting pre‐tax book losses increased from about 20% to 40% during 1988–2023. We also observe that 68% of those loss firms have positive cash tax payments (taxpaying loss firms). The amount of taxes paid by these loss firms is substantial and increasing over time. Surprisingly, we observe that taxes paid increase with the magnitude of pre‐tax losses. This study seeks to understand the prevalence of taxpaying loss firms. We examine whether both the extensive margin—the likelihood that a loss firm pays taxes—and the intensive margin—the magnitude of taxes paid—are explained by firm characteristics. We find that multinational status, state taxes, consolidation differences, goodwill impairments, asset write‐downs, extraordinary items, discontinued operations, depreciation differences, the frequency and magnitude of losses, and firm size are key determinants of both the likelihood and the amount of taxes paid by loss firms. We find that the decrease in the statutory tax rate included in the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act of 2017 did not decrease the tax burden on loss firms.

before.title_zh: 亏损公司的税款支付
before.abstract_zh: 在一个广泛的上市公司样本中，我们观察到，在1988年至2023年期间，年度报告税前账面亏损的公司比例从约20%上升至40%。我们还观察到，这些亏损公司中有68%具有正数的现金税款支付（即纳税的亏损公司）。这些亏损公司所支付的税款金额相当可观，并且随时间推移而增加。令人惊讶的是，我们观察到所支付的税款随着税前亏损规模的增大而增加。本研究旨在理解纳税亏损公司的普遍性。我们考察了广延边际——亏损公司支付税款的可能性——和集约边际——所支付税款的规模——是否都能由公司特征来解释。我们发现，跨国身份、州税、合并差异、商誉减值、资产减记、非常项目、终止经营、折旧差异、亏损的频率和规模以及公司规模，是亏损公司支付税款的可能性和金额两者的关键决定因素。我们发现，2017年《减税与就业法案》中所包含的法定税率下调并未减轻亏损公司的税收负担。

existing_records.title: Tax Payments in Loss Firms
existing_records.abstract: In a broad sample of publicly traded firms, we observe that the share of firms annually reporting pre‐tax book losses increased from about 20% to 40% during 1988–2023. We also observe that 68% of those loss firms have positive cash tax payments (taxpaying loss firms). The amount of taxes paid by these loss firms is substantial and increasing over time. Surprisingly, we observe that taxes paid increase with the magnitude of pre‐tax losses. This study seeks to understand the prevalence of taxpaying loss firms. We examine whether both the extensive margin—the likelihood that a loss firm pays taxes—and the intensive margin—the magnitude of taxes paid—are explained by firm characteristics. We find that multinational status, state taxes, consolidation differences, goodwill impairments, asset write‐downs, extraordinary items, discontinued operations, depreciation differences, the frequency and magnitude of losses, and firm size are key determinants of both the likelihood and the amount of taxes paid by loss firms. We find that the decrease in the statutory tax rate included in the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act of 2017 did not decrease the tax burden on loss firms.

after.title_zh: 亏损公司的税款支付
after.abstract_zh: 在一个广泛的上市公司样本中，我们观察到，在1988年至2023年期间，年度报告税前账面亏损的公司比例从约20%上升至40%。我们还观察到，这些亏损公司中有68%具有正数的现金税款支付（即纳税的亏损公司）。这些亏损公司所支付的税款金额相当可观，并且随时间推移而增加。令人惊讶的是，我们观察到所支付的税款随着税前亏损规模的增大而增加。本研究旨在理解纳税亏损公司的普遍性。我们考察了广延边际——亏损公司支付税款的可能性——和集约边际——所支付税款的规模——是否都能由公司特征来解释。我们发现，跨国身份、州税、合并差异、商誉减值、资产减记、非常项目、终止经营、折旧差异、亏损的频率和规模以及公司规模，是亏损公司支付税款的可能性和金额两者的关键决定因素。我们发现，2017年《减税与就业法案》中所包含的法定税率下调并未减轻亏损公司的税收负担。

source_records.raw_title: Out of the Office: Market Impacts of Institutional Investor DistractionAbsence du bureau : la distraction des grands investisseurs et ses impacts sur le marché
source_records.raw_abstract:
ABSTRACT
Research has long recognized that institutional investors possess significant information processing advantages. Yet even these investors face limited‐attention constraints, implying that periods of distraction may attenuate their advantage. We examine the effects of a plausibly exogenous shock to institutional attention arising from the annual buy‐side‐focused Equity Research and Valuation (ERV) conference for Chartered Financial Analysts on institutions' information processing at earnings announcements. Validation tests using conference call data indicate that fewer buy‐side analysts are present on earnings calls during ERV conferences and that questions are shorter, consistent with the presence of substitute or backup analysts. In our main analyses, we find that buy‐side analyst inattention reduces information asymmetry among investors and improves liquidity at these earnings announcements, consistent with theory, and observe similar results for non–earnings announcement events. In additional tests, we document slower price formation, but also more profitable retail trading, during these periods. Collectively, we provide novel evidence on the market consequences of institutional inattention during key information events.

RÉSUMÉ
De précédentes études démontrent clairement que les grands investisseurs disposent d'avantages significatifs en matière de traitement de l'information. Cependant, même ces investisseurs sont confrontés à des contraintes inhérentes à l'attention limitée, de sorte que certaines périodes de distraction peuvent l'emporter sur leur avantage. Cette étude examine les effets d'un choc exogène — causé par la tenue de la conférence annuelle Equity Research and Valuation (ERV), axée sur l'achat et destinée aux analystes financiers agréés — sur l'attention accordée au traitement de l'information par les institutions au cours des annonces de résultats. Les tests de validation basés sur les données issues des conférences téléphoniques indiquent qu'un nombre réduit d'analystes du côté de l'acquéreur participent aux appels concernant les résultats lors des conférences ERV, et que les interventions sont plus brèves, ce qui suggère la présence d'analystes substituts ou de remplaçants. Les principaux éléments d'analyse montrent que l'inattention des analystes du côté de l'acquéreur diminue l'asymétrie des informations entre les investisseurs et améliore la liquidité durant ces annonces de résultats, conformément aux prédictions théoriques. Des résultats similaires sont observés pour les événements autres que les annonces de résultats. Des tests complémentaires révèlent une formation des prix plus lente, mais également une rentabilité accrue du commerce de détail pendant ces périodes. Dans l'ensemble, les auteurs apportent de nouvelles preuves quant aux conséquences sur le marché de l'inattention des institutions lors d'événements clés en matière d'information.

before.title_zh: 离开办公室：机构投资者注意力分散的市场影响
before.abstract_zh: 研究早已认识到，机构投资者拥有显著的信息处理优势。然而，即便是这些投资者也面临有限注意力的约束，这意味着分心时期可能会削弱其优势。我们考察了由特许金融分析师协会每年举办的、以买方为重点的股票研究与估值（ERV）会议所引发的机构注意力外生冲击对机构在盈余公告时信息处理的影响。使用电话会议数据进行的验证测试表明，在ERV会议期间，出席盈余电话会议的买方分析师人数减少，且提问更短，这与存在替代或后备分析师的情况一致。在我们的主要分析中，我们发现买方分析师注意力不集中降低了投资者之间的信息不对称，并改善了这些盈余公告时的流动性，这与理论一致，并且对于非盈余公告事件也观察到类似结果。在额外测试中，我们记录了在这些时期价格形成更慢，但散户交易也更有利可图。总体而言，我们提供了关于机构注意力不集中在关键信息事件期间的市场后果的新证据。

existing_records.title: Out of the Office: Market Impacts of Institutional Investor Distraction
existing_records.abstract: Research has long recognized that institutional investors possess significant information processing advantages. Yet even these investors face limited‐attention constraints, implying that periods of distraction may attenuate their advantage. We examine the effects of a plausibly exogenous shock to institutional attention arising from the annual buy‐side‐focused Equity Research and Valuation (ERV) conference for Chartered Financial Analysts on institutions' information processing at earnings announcements. Validation tests using conference call data indicate that fewer buy‐side analysts are present on earnings calls during ERV conferences and that questions are shorter, consistent with the presence of substitute or backup analysts. In our main analyses, we find that buy‐side analyst inattention reduces information asymmetry among investors and improves liquidity at these earnings announcements, consistent with theory, and observe similar results for non–earnings announcement events. In additional tests, we document slower price formation, but also more profitable retail trading, during these periods. Collectively, we provide novel evidence on the market consequences of institutional inattention during key information events.

after.title_zh: 离开办公室：机构投资者注意力分散的市场影响
after.abstract_zh: 研究早已认识到，机构投资者拥有显著的信息处理优势。然而，即便是这些投资者也面临有限注意力的约束，这意味着分心时期可能会削弱其优势。我们考察了由特许金融分析师协会每年举办的、以买方为重点的股票研究与估值（ERV）会议所引发的机构注意力外生冲击对机构在盈余公告时信息处理的影响。使用电话会议数据进行的验证测试表明，在ERV会议期间，出席盈余电话会议的买方分析师人数减少，且提问更短，这与存在替代或后备分析师的情况一致。在我们的主要分析中，我们发现买方分析师注意力不集中降低了投资者之间的信息不对称，并改善了这些盈余公告时的流动性，这与理论一致，并且对于非盈余公告事件也观察到类似结果。在额外测试中，我们记录了在这些时期价格形成更慢，但散户交易也更有利可图。总体而言，我们提供了关于机构注意力不集中在关键信息事件期间的市场后果的新证据。

source_records.title: Does Mobile Communication Technology Have Capital Market Consequences? Evidence From Worldwide Launches of 3G Networks
source_records.abstract: Exploiting the staggered rollout of third‐generation (3G) mobile broadband networks across 40 countries between 1999 and 2012, we examine how technological progress affects capital markets. We find that the introduction of 3G networks is followed by a reduction in bid‐ask spreads and an increase in price informativeness. These effects are more pronounced among firms with lower institutional ownership, indicating that information access through mobile broadband networks disproportionally benefits retail investors. We further show that these effects are concentrated in countries with well‐functioning markets, as characterized by transparent accounting information, broad investor participation, and strong legal protections for investors. Taken together, our findings suggest that mobile broadband connectivity reduces information frictions and improves price informativeness. They further highlight the institutional conditions under which these benefits materialize.

source_records.raw_title: Does Mobile Communication Technology Have Capital Market Consequences? Evidence From Worldwide Launches of 3G NetworksLa technologie cellulaire a‐t‐elle des incidences sur les marchés financiers? Données issues du déploiement mondial des réseaux 3G
source_records.raw_abstract:
ABSTRACT
Exploiting the staggered rollout of third‐generation (3G) mobile broadband networks across 40 countries between 1999 and 2012, we examine how technological progress affects capital markets. We find that the introduction of 3G networks is followed by a reduction in bid‐ask spreads and an increase in price informativeness. These effects are more pronounced among firms with lower institutional ownership, indicating that information access through mobile broadband networks disproportionally benefits retail investors. We further show that these effects are concentrated in countries with well‐functioning markets, as characterized by transparent accounting information, broad investor participation, and strong legal protections for investors. Taken together, our findings suggest that mobile broadband connectivity reduces information frictions and improves price informativeness. They further highlight the institutional conditions under which these benefits materialize.

RÉSUMÉ
À l'aide du déploiement progressif des réseaux mobiles à large bande de troisième génération (3G) au sein de 40 pays entre 1999 et 2012, cette étude analyse comment le progrès technologique influe sur les marchés financiers. Les auteurs démontrent que l'implantation des réseaux 3G est corrélée avec une réduction des écarts acheteur‐vendeur et une augmentation de la valeur informative du cours des actions. Ces effets sont plus marqués chez les entreprises dont l'investissement institutionnel est inférieur, suggérant de très fortes inégalités dans l'accès à l'information via les réseaux mobiles à large bande au profit des investisseurs particuliers. En outre, l'étude souligne que ces effets se produisent surtout dans les pays dotés de marchés matures, caractérisés par une transparence comptable accrue, une participation élargie des investisseurs et des protections juridiques efficaces pour ces derniers. Dans l'ensemble, les résultats tendent à démontrer que la connectivité à large bande mobile réduit les frictions informationnelles et accroît la valeur informative du cours des actions. Enfin, les auteurs mettent en avant les conditions institutionnelles nécessaires à l'obtention de ces avantages.

before.title_zh: 移动通信技术是否具有资本市场后果？来自全球3G网络商用的证据
before.abstract_zh: 利用1999年至2012年间40个国家第三代（3G）移动宽带网络的交错推出，我们考察了技术进步如何影响资本市场。我们发现，3G网络的引入之后伴随着买卖价差的缩小和价格信息含量的提高。这些效应在机构持股比例较低的公司中更为显著，表明通过移动宽带网络获取信息不成比例地惠及了散户投资者。我们进一步表明，这些效应集中在市场运行良好的国家，其特征是会计信息透明、投资者参与广泛以及投资者法律保护有力。综合来看，我们的发现表明，移动宽带连接减少了信息摩擦并提高了价格信息含量。它们进一步凸显了这些益处得以实现的制度条件。

after.title_original: Does Mobile Communication Technology Have Capital Market Consequences? Evidence From Worldwide Launches of 3G NetworksLa technologie cellulaire a-t-elle des incidences sur les marchés financiers? Données issues du déploiement mondial des réseaux 3G
after.abstract_original: Exploiting the staggered rollout of third‐generation (3G) mobile broadband networks across 40 countries between 1999 and 2012, we examine how technological progress affects capital markets. We find that the introduction of 3G networks is followed by a reduction in bid‐ask spreads and an increase in price informativeness. These effects are more pronounced among firms with lower institutional ownership, indicating that information access through mobile broadband networks disproportionally benefits retail investors. We further show that these effects are concentrated in countries with well‐functioning markets, as characterized by transparent accounting information, broad investor participation, and strong legal protections for investors. Taken together, our findings suggest that mobile broadband connectivity reduces information frictions and improves price informativeness. They further highlight the institutional conditions under which these benefits materialize.

after.title_zh: 移动通信技术是否具有资本市场后果？来自全球3G网络商用的证据
after.abstract_zh: 利用1999年至2012年间40个国家第三代（3G）移动宽带网络的交错推出，我们考察了技术进步如何影响资本市场。我们发现，3G网络的引入之后伴随着买卖价差的缩小和价格信息含量的提高。这些效应在机构持股比例较低的公司中更为显著，表明通过移动宽带网络获取信息不成比例地惠及了散户投资者。我们进一步表明，这些效应集中在市场运行良好的国家，其特征是会计信息透明、投资者参与广泛以及投资者法律保护有力。综合来看，我们的发现表明，移动宽带连接减少了信息摩擦并提高了价格信息含量。它们进一步凸显了这些益处得以实现的制度条件。

source_records.title: Do Key Audit Matters in Hong Kong and Mainland China Provide Incremental Information and Improve Audit Quality?
source_records.abstract: We examine the adoption of expanded audit reports that include key audit matters (KAMs) in Hong Kong (2016) and mainland China (2017). These jurisdictions are highly integrated and together constitute one of the largest economies to adopt the IAASB's reporting standards in a staggered fashion, while also differing in investor protection and legal enforcement. Using matched samples, pre‐post tests, and staggered difference‐in‐differences analyses with company fixed effects, we do not find compelling evidence that expanded audit reports affect market reactions or audit quality. These findings suggest a substantial gap between regulatory intent and implementation—on average, in these markets, KAMs do not appear to meet investors' demand for incremental information or to improve audit quality substantially. At the same time, our cross‐sectional evidence on KAM characteristics is more nuanced. A higher number of KAMs and the presence of novel or transaction‐specific KAMs are associated with stronger pricing of fundamentals, consistent with investors perceiving the related financial statements as better vetted. Yet a higher number of KAMs and novel KAMs are also associated with lower profitability persistence, consistent with these disclosures reflecting company risk and volatility. In contrast, industry‐common KAMs appear less relevant for valuation, consistent with investors discounting routine disclosures, even though they are associated with more persistent performance likely reflecting more stable industry conditions. Overall, our evidence suggests that mandating expanded audit reports alone may be of limited value, whereas better tailored KAM disclosures may still serve as signals of firm fundamentals and future performance.

before.title_zh: 香港和中国内地的关键审计事项是否提供增量信息并提高审计质量？
before.abstract_zh: 我们考察了香港（2016年）和中国内地（2017年）采用包含关键审计事项（KAMs）的扩展审计报告的情况。这两个司法管辖区高度一体化，共同构成了以交错方式采用国际审计与鉴证准则理事会（IAASB）报告准则的最大经济体之一，同时在投资者保护和法律执行方面存在差异。使用匹配样本、前后对比检验以及带有公司固定效应的交错双重差分分析，我们未发现令人信服的证据表明扩展审计报告影响市场反应或审计质量。这些发现表明监管意图与实施之间存在实质性差距——平均而言，在这些市场中，KAMs似乎既不能满足投资者对增量信息的需求，也不能大幅提高审计质量。与此同时，我们关于KAM特征的横截面证据则更为细致。KAM数量较多以及存在新颖或交易特定KAM与基本面定价更强相关，这与投资者认为相关财务报表得到更好审查的认知一致。然而，KAM数量较多和新颖KAM也与较低的盈利持续性相关，这与这些披露反映公司风险和波动性一致。相比之下，行业常见的KAM似乎与估值相关性较低，这与投资者对常规披露给予折价一致，尽管它们与更持续的业绩相关，可能反映更稳定的行业状况。总体而言，我们的证据表明，仅强制要求扩展审计报告可能价值有限，而更具针对性的KAM披露仍可作为公司基本面和未来业绩的信号。

after.title_zh: 香港和中国内地的关键审计事项是否提供增量信息并提高审计质量？
after.abstract_zh: 我们考察了香港（2016年）和中国内地（2017年）采用包含关键审计事项（KAMs）的扩展审计报告的情况。这两个司法管辖区高度一体化，共同构成了以交错方式采用国际审计与鉴证准则理事会（IAASB）报告准则的最大经济体之一，同时在投资者保护和法律执行方面存在差异。使用匹配样本、前后对比检验以及带有公司固定效应的交错双重差分分析，我们未发现令人信服的证据表明扩展审计报告影响市场反应或审计质量。这些发现表明监管意图与实施之间存在实质性差距——平均而言，在这些市场中，KAMs似乎既不能满足投资者对增量信息的需求，也不能大幅提高审计质量。与此同时，我们关于KAM特征的横截面证据则更为细致。KAM数量较多以及存在新颖或交易特定KAM与基本面定价更强相关，这与投资者认为相关财务报表得到更好审查的认知一致。然而，KAM数量较多和新颖KAM也与较低的盈利持续性相关，这与这些披露反映公司风险和波动性一致。相比之下，行业常见的KAM似乎与估值相关性较低，这与投资者对常规披露给予折价一致，尽管它们与更持续的业绩相关，可能反映更稳定的行业状况。总体而言，我们的证据表明，仅强制要求扩展审计报告可能价值有限，而更具针对性的KAM披露仍可作为公司基本面和未来业绩的信号。
