existing_records.abstract: We examine the adoption of expanded audit reports that include key audit matters (KAMs) in Hong Kong (2016) and mainland China (2017). These jurisdictions are highly integrated and together constitute one of the largest economies to adopt the IAASB's reporting standards in a staggered fashion, while also differing in investor protection and legal enforcement. Using matched samples, pre‐post tests, and staggered difference‐in‐differences analyses with company fixed effects, we do not find compelling evidence that expanded audit reports affect market reactions or audit quality. These findings suggest a substantial gap between regulatory intent and implementation—on average, in these markets, KAMs do not appear to meet investors' demand for incremental information or to improve audit quality substantially. At the same time, our cross‐sectional evidence on KAM characteristics is more nuanced. A higher number of KAMs and the presence of novel or transaction‐specific KAMs are associated with stronger pricing of fundamentals, consistent with investors perceiving the related financial statements as better vetted. Yet a higher number of KAMs and novel KAMs are also associated with lower profitability persistence, consistent with these disclosures reflecting company risk and volatility. In contrast, industry‐common KAMs appear less relevant for valuation, consistent with investors discounting routine disclosures, even though they are associated with more persistent performance likely reflecting more stable industry conditions. Overall, our evidence suggests that mandating expanded audit reports alone may be of limited value, whereas better tailored KAM disclosures may still serve as signals of firm fundamentals and future performance.

source_records.raw_title: Analysts' Cultural Long‐Term Orientation and Their Information ProductionOrientation culturelle à long terme des analystes et production d'information
source_records.raw_abstract:
ABSTRACT
We study how analysts' inherited cultural attitudes to time orientation affect their production of long‐term information and the profitability of their stock recommendations. We find that analysts from long‐term‐oriented cultures exhibit a longer forecast horizon and issue more long‐term forecasts. They also produce more accurate long‐term forecasts and ask more long‐term‐focused questions during conference calls, eliciting greater long‐term disclosure from managers. In addition, they are more likely to use discounted valuation models that explicitly incorporate expectations about firms' long‐term prospects. Further, their stock recommendations are more profitable, consistent with their production of long‐term information enhancing valuation. Our findings highlight the role of cultural long‐term orientation in shaping analysts' information production in capital markets.

RÉSUMÉ
Nous examinons de quelle façon les attitudes culturelles acquises des analystes en matière d'orientation temporelle influencent leur production d'information à long terme et la rentabilité de leurs recommandations boursières. Nous établissons que l'horizon de prévision des analystes issus de cultures orientées sur le long terme est plus étendu et que ceux‐ci font davantage de prévisions à long terme. Ils produisent aussi des prévisions à long terme plus précises et posent plus de questions en ce sens lors des conférences téléphoniques, ce qui pousse les gestionnaires à divulguer davantage d'information à long terme. En outre, ces analystes sont plus susceptibles d'utiliser des modèles d'évaluation actualisés qui intègrent explicitement les attentes concernant les perspectives à long terme des entreprises. Leurs recommandations boursières sont également plus rentables, ce qui est cohérent avec le fait que leur production d'information à long terme améliore l'évaluation. Nos observations mettent en lumière l'influence de l'orientation culturelle à long terme dans la production d'information des analystes sur les marchés boursiers.

before.title_zh: 分析师的文化长期导向与其信息生产
before.abstract_zh: 我们研究分析师继承的关于时间导向的文化态度如何影响其长期信息的生产及其股票推荐建议的盈利能力。我们发现，来自长期导向文化的分析师表现出更长的预测期限，并发布更多长期预测。他们还生产更准确的长期预测，并在电话会议中提出更多聚焦长期的问题，从而促使管理者进行更多长期披露。此外，他们更可能使用明确纳入对公司长期前景预期的折现估值模型。进一步而言，他们的股票推荐建议盈利能力更强，这与其长期信息的生产提升了估值相一致。我们的发现凸显了文化长期导向在塑造资本市场中分析师信息生产方面的作用。

after.title_zh: 分析师的文化长期导向与其信息生产
after.abstract_zh: 我们研究分析师继承的关于时间导向的文化态度如何影响其长期信息的生产及其股票推荐建议的盈利能力。我们发现，来自长期导向文化的分析师表现出更长的预测期限，并发布更多长期预测。他们还生产更准确的长期预测，并在电话会议中提出更多聚焦长期的问题，从而促使管理者进行更多长期披露。此外，他们更可能使用明确纳入对公司长期前景预期的折现估值模型。进一步而言，他们的股票推荐建议盈利能力更强，这与其长期信息的生产提升了估值相一致。我们的发现凸显了文化长期导向在塑造资本市场中分析师信息生产方面的作用。

source_records.title: Seek and Ye Might Not Find: The Effects of Contract Framing on Knowledge Sharing and Knowledge Seeking
source_records.abstract: We conduct two experiments to examine whether and how the framing (bonus vs. penalty) of a target‐based incentive contract affects knowledge sharing and knowledge seeking. In the first experiment, we predict and find that penalty‐framed contracts increase employees' stress due to the fear of potential loss, which in turn reduces their willingness to share knowledge. Additionally, consistent with loss aversion, employees under penalty‐framed contracts are more likely to seek knowledge than those under bonus‐framed contracts. The second experiment corroborates our theoretical arguments by demonstrating the crucial role of stress in reducing knowledge‐sharing behavior. The results show that, when stress is alleviated through an informal control mechanism, penalty‐framed contracts no longer reduce knowledge sharing. The implications of our findings for research and practice are discussed.

source_records.raw_abstract:
ABSTRACT
We conduct two experiments to examine whether and how the framing (bonus vs. penalty) of a target‐based incentive contract affects knowledge sharing and knowledge seeking. In the first experiment, we predict and find that penalty‐framed contracts increase employees' stress due to the fear of potential loss, which in turn reduces their willingness to share knowledge. Additionally, consistent with loss aversion, employees under penalty‐framed contracts are more likely to seek knowledge than those under bonus‐framed contracts. The second experiment corroborates our theoretical arguments by demonstrating the crucial role of stress in reducing knowledge‐sharing behavior. The results show that, when stress is alleviated through an informal control mechanism, penalty‐framed contracts no longer reduce knowledge sharing. The implications of our findings for research and practice are discussed.

RÉSUMÉ
Les auteurs conduisent deux expériences visant à examiner dans quelle mesure le processus de formulation (axé sur la prime ou la pénalité) d'un contrat d'intéressement lié à l'atteinte des objectifs influe sur le partage et la recherche de renseignements. Dans la première expérience, ils formulent et confirment l'hypothèse selon laquelle les contrats portant sur des pénalités accroissent le niveau de stress des employés en raison de la crainte d'une perte potentielle, ce qui freine leur propension à partager des renseignements. Par ailleurs, conformément au principe d'aversion aux pertes, les employés liés à des contrats portant sur des pénalités sont plus enclins à chercher des renseignements que ceux liés à des contrats portant sur des primes. La deuxième expérience vient appuyer leurs hypothèses théoriques en démontrant le rôle crucial du stress dans la propension des employés à partager des renseignements. Les résultats montrent que, lorsque le stress est atténué grâce à un mécanisme de contrôle informel, les contrats portant sur des pénalités ne freinent plus la propension à partager des renseignements. Les implications de ces résultats pour la recherche et la pratique sont ensuite discutées.

before.title_zh: 寻求未必得：合同框架对知识分享与知识寻求的影响
before.abstract_zh: 我们进行了两项实验，以考察基于目标的激励合同的框架（奖金与罚金）是否以及如何影响知识分享与知识寻求。在第一项实验中，我们预测并发现，罚金框架合同会因对潜在损失的恐惧而增加员工的压力，进而降低其分享知识的意愿。此外，与损失厌恶一致，罚金框架合同下的员工比奖金框架合同下的员工更倾向于寻求知识。第二项实验通过证明压力在减少知识分享行为中的关键作用，印证了我们的理论论点。结果表明，当通过非正式控制机制缓解压力时，罚金框架合同不再减少知识分享。我们讨论了研究发现对研究与实务的启示。

existing_records.title: Seek and Ye Might Not Find: The Effects of Contract Framing on Knowledge Sharing and Knowledge Seeking
existing_records.abstract: We conduct two experiments to examine whether and how the framing (bonus vs. penalty) of a target‐based incentive contract affects knowledge sharing and knowledge seeking. In the first experiment, we predict and find that penalty‐framed contracts increase employees' stress due to the fear of potential loss, which in turn reduces their willingness to share knowledge. Additionally, consistent with loss aversion, employees under penalty‐framed contracts are more likely to seek knowledge than those under bonus‐framed contracts. The second experiment corroborates our theoretical arguments by demonstrating the crucial role of stress in reducing knowledge‐sharing behavior. The results show that, when stress is alleviated through an informal control mechanism, penalty‐framed contracts no longer reduce knowledge sharing. The implications of our findings for research and practice are discussed.

after.title_zh: 寻求未必得：合同框架对知识分享与知识寻求的影响
after.abstract_zh: 我们进行了两项实验，以考察基于目标的激励合同的框架（奖金与罚金）是否以及如何影响知识分享与知识寻求。在第一项实验中，我们预测并发现，罚金框架合同会因对潜在损失的恐惧而增加员工的压力，进而降低其分享知识的意愿。此外，与损失厌恶一致，罚金框架合同下的员工比奖金框架合同下的员工更倾向于寻求知识。第二项实验通过证明压力在减少知识分享行为中的关键作用，印证了我们的理论论点。结果表明，当通过非正式控制机制缓解压力时，罚金框架合同不再减少知识分享。我们讨论了研究发现对研究与实务的启示。

source_records.title: Product Market Threats: Implications for Future Performance and Use by Market Participants
source_records.abstract: This study examines whether competition in the form of emerging threats from rivals' overlapping product strategies has explanatory power for future performance and volatility, beyond existing competition measures and firm life cycle proxies. We proxy for emerging threats using product market fluidity, which captures competitive pressures and instability arising from rivals' evolving product overlap. Specifically, higher fluidity (i.e., higher product market threats) is negatively associated with future profitability and operating cash flows and positively associated with the variability of future profitability and operating cash flows. We also find fluidity is negatively associated with future asset turnover, margins, and expenses, and only moderately positively associated with future sales, shedding light on the mechanisms through which product market threats manifest in future performance. However, capital market participants do not fully incorporate this information, leading to predictable future stock returns and analyst forecast errors. Overall, our findings suggest that the dynamism and fluidity in a firm's product market space convey valuable and distinct information to capital market participants.

source_records.raw_title: Product Market Threats: Implications for Future Performance and Use by Market ParticipantsMenaces sur le marché des produits : incidences sur le rendement futur et utilisation par les participants au marché
source_records.raw_abstract:
ABSTRACT
This study examines whether competition in the form of emerging threats from rivals' overlapping product strategies has explanatory power for future performance and volatility, beyond existing competition measures and firm life cycle proxies. We proxy for emerging threats using product market fluidity, which captures competitive pressures and instability arising from rivals' evolving product overlap. Specifically, higher fluidity (i.e., higher product market threats) is negatively associated with future profitability and operating cash flows and positively associated with the variability of future profitability and operating cash flows. We also find fluidity is negatively associated with future asset turnover, margins, and expenses, and only moderately positively associated with future sales, shedding light on the mechanisms through which product market threats manifest in future performance. However, capital market participants do not fully incorporate this information, leading to predictable future stock returns and analyst forecast errors. Overall, our findings suggest that the dynamism and fluidity in a firm's product market space convey valuable and distinct information to capital market participants.

RÉSUMÉ
Cette étude examine si la concurrence, appréhendée par les menaces émergentes liées au chevauchement des stratégies de produit, possède un pouvoir explicatif sur le rendement et la volatilité futurs, au‐delà des indicateurs de concurrence existants et des variables représentatives du cycle de vie des entreprises. Les auteurs utilisent la fluidité du marché des produits comme variable représentative des menaces émergentes, celle‐ci reflétant les pressions concurrentielles et l'instabilité provoquée par les activités de chevauchement des produits entre concurrents. Plus précisément, le haut degré de fluidité (c'est‐à‐dire des menaces plus sérieuses sur le marché des produits) est négativement corrélé à la rentabilité future et aux flux de trésorerie d'exploitation, tandis qu'il est positivement corrélé à la variation de la rentabilité future et aux flux de trésorerie d'exploitation. Les auteurs démontrent également que la fluidité est négativement corrélée à la rotation future de l'actif, aux marges et aux charges, tandis qu'elle est modérément et positivement corrélée aux ventes futures, mettant ainsi en évidence les mécanismes par lesquels les menaces sur le marché des produits se concrétisent au niveau des rendements futurs. Toutefois, les participants aux marchés financiers n'intègrent pas tout à fait ces informations, ce qui génère une prévisibilité des rendements des actions futurs et des erreurs de prévision de la part des analystes. Dans l'ensemble, les résultats suggèrent que le dynamisme et la fluidité de l'espace produit‐marché d'une entreprise représentent une source précieuse d'informations pour les participants aux marchés financiers.

before.title_zh: 产品市场威胁：对未来业绩及市场参与者使用的影响
before.abstract_zh: 本研究考察了以竞争对手重叠产品策略所产生的新兴威胁为形式的竞争，是否在现有竞争衡量指标和企业生命周期代理变量之外，对未来业绩和波动性具有解释力。我们使用产品市场流动性来代理新兴威胁，该指标捕捉了因竞争对手不断演变的产品重叠而产生的竞争压力和不稳定性。具体而言，较高的流动性（即较高的产品市场威胁）与未来盈利能力和经营现金流负相关，与未来盈利能力和经营现金流的变异性正相关。我们还发现，流动性对未来资产周转率、利润率和费用具有负向关联，而仅对未来销售额具有中等程度的正向关联，这揭示了产品市场威胁在未来业绩中体现的机制。然而，资本市场参与者并未完全纳入这一信息，从而导致可预测的未来股票收益和分析师预测误差。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，企业产品市场空间中的动态性和流动性向资本市场参与者传递了有价值且独特的信息。

existing_records.title: Product Market Threats: Implications for Future Performance and Use by Market Participants
existing_records.abstract: This study examines whether competition in the form of emerging threats from rivals' overlapping product strategies has explanatory power for future performance and volatility, beyond existing competition measures and firm life cycle proxies. We proxy for emerging threats using product market fluidity, which captures competitive pressures and instability arising from rivals' evolving product overlap. Specifically, higher fluidity (i.e., higher product market threats) is negatively associated with future profitability and operating cash flows and positively associated with the variability of future profitability and operating cash flows. We also find fluidity is negatively associated with future asset turnover, margins, and expenses, and only moderately positively associated with future sales, shedding light on the mechanisms through which product market threats manifest in future performance. However, capital market participants do not fully incorporate this information, leading to predictable future stock returns and analyst forecast errors. Overall, our findings suggest that the dynamism and fluidity in a firm's product market space convey valuable and distinct information to capital market participants.

after.title_zh: 产品市场威胁：对未来业绩及市场参与者使用的影响
after.abstract_zh: 本研究考察了以竞争对手重叠产品策略所产生的新兴威胁为形式的竞争，是否在现有竞争衡量指标和企业生命周期代理变量之外，对未来业绩和波动性具有解释力。我们使用产品市场流动性来代理新兴威胁，该指标捕捉了因竞争对手不断演变的产品重叠而产生的竞争压力和不稳定性。具体而言，较高的流动性（即较高的产品市场威胁）与未来盈利能力和经营现金流负相关，与未来盈利能力和经营现金流的变异性正相关。我们还发现，流动性对未来资产周转率、利润率和费用具有负向关联，而仅对未来销售额具有中等程度的正向关联，这揭示了产品市场威胁在未来业绩中体现的机制。然而，资本市场参与者并未完全纳入这一信息，从而导致可预测的未来股票收益和分析师预测误差。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，企业产品市场空间中的动态性和流动性向资本市场参与者传递了有价值且独特的信息。

source_records.title: Regulatory Intermediation in Times of Crisis: The Impact of Independent Oversight on the Functioning of Professional Accounting Bodies
source_records.abstract: The rise of independent oversight of the accounting profession has attracted considerable research attention. Much of this research has studied how professional accounting bodies and the Big 4 firms have shaped the mandate and capabilities of independent oversight bodies. Less is known about how independent oversight has affected the workings of professional accounting bodies, particularly their capacity to simultaneously govern and represent their members. This paper advances our understanding of this dynamic through a longitudinal, interpretive case study of how the Dutch professional accounting body, the NBA (the Royal Netherlands Institute of Chartered Accountants), adapted and developed its regulatory intermediary role during a lengthy period of intense oversight by the Dutch regulator, the AFM (the Authority for the Financial Markets), and shifting levels of Big 4 firm discord. Drawing on extensive archival materials and insights gained from in‐depth interviews with key participants, the study advances existing theorizations of the work of regulatory intermediaries by highlighting both their functional variability and fragility. In responding to recurring crises and critique, the NBA's intermediary role shifted from facilitation to curation and ultimately to orchestrating the Big 4 firms' regulatory response. Such shifts were neither smooth nor predictable—characterized by a sense of “role limbo” as the NBA battled to bolster its identity and authority when sidelined by the AFM or dictated to or impeded by the Big 4 firms. In examining such shifting intermediation and contesting levels of influence, the NBA's governance and representation functions emerge as more symbiotic than oppositional, with the NBA using its fulfillment of one as a means of strengthening its execution of the other. Overall, the paper's analysis uncovers the functional fragility of the NBA, which questions whether repeated calls for professional accounting bodies to rediscover their public interest mandate have adequately appreciated the complex, contested nature of the regulatory environment in which they operate.

source_records.raw_abstract:
ABSTRACT
The rise of independent oversight of the accounting profession has attracted considerable research attention. Much of this research has studied how professional accounting bodies and the Big 4 firms have shaped the mandate and capabilities of independent oversight bodies. Less is known about how independent oversight has affected the workings of professional accounting bodies, particularly their capacity to simultaneously govern and represent their members. This paper advances our understanding of this dynamic through a longitudinal, interpretive case study of how the Dutch professional accounting body, the NBA (the Royal Netherlands Institute of Chartered Accountants), adapted and developed its regulatory intermediary role during a lengthy period of intense oversight by the Dutch regulator, the AFM (the Authority for the Financial Markets), and shifting levels of Big 4 firm discord. Drawing on extensive archival materials and insights gained from in‐depth interviews with key participants, the study advances existing theorizations of the work of regulatory intermediaries by highlighting both their functional variability and fragility. In responding to recurring crises and critique, the NBA's intermediary role shifted from facilitation to curation and ultimately to orchestrating the Big 4 firms' regulatory response. Such shifts were neither smooth nor predictable—characterized by a sense of “role limbo” as the NBA battled to bolster its identity and authority when sidelined by the AFM or dictated to or impeded by the Big 4 firms. In examining such shifting intermediation and contesting levels of influence, the NBA's governance and representation functions emerge as more symbiotic than oppositional, with the NBA using its fulfillment of one as a means of strengthening its execution of the other. Overall, the paper's analysis uncovers the functional fragility of the NBA, which questions whether repeated calls for professional accounting bodies to rediscover their public interest mandate have adequately appreciated the complex, contested nature of the regulatory environment in which they operate.

RÉSUMÉ
L'essor de la surveillance indépendante de la profession comptable a suscité un intérêt considérable auprès des chercheurs. La plupart des études sur le sujet se sont penchées sur la façon dont les organismes comptables professionnels et les quatre grands cabinets d'audit (Big 4) ont influencé le mandat et les capacités des organismes de surveillance indépendants. Toutefois, on en sait moins à propos de l'incidence de la surveillance indépendante sur le fonctionnement des organismes comptables professionnels, en particulier leur capacité à simultanément régir leurs membres et les représenter. Le présent article approfondit notre compréhension de cette dynamique dans le cadre d'une étude de cas longitudinale et interprétative sur la façon dont l'organisme comptable professionnel néerlandais, le NBA (institut royal néerlandais des comptables agréés), a adapté et développé son rôle d'intermédiaire réglementaire pendant une période prolongée de surveillance soutenue exercée par l'organisme de réglementation néerlandais, l'AFM (autorité des marchés financiers), marquée par des dissensions d'intensité variable avec les cabinets du Big 4. En s'appuyant sur un vaste corpus de documents d'archives et des observations issues d'entrevues en profondeur avec des participants clés, l'étude fait progresser les théories existantes concernant le travail des intermédiaires réglementaires en mettant en lumière à la fois leur variabilité et leur fragilité fonctionnelles. En répondant aux crises et aux critiques récurrentes, le NBA a vu son rôle d'intermédiaire passer d'une fonction de facilitation à une fonction d'organisation et, ultimement, à une fonction d'orchestration de la réponse réglementaire des quatre grands cabinets. Ces changements ne se sont pas opérés de manière fluide ni prévisible ; ils ont plutôt été caractérisés par une incertitude quant au rôle à jouer, le NBA s'efforçant de raffermir son identité et son autorité au moment où l'AFM le mettait à l'écart ou lorsque les quatre grands cabinets lui dictaient ou entravaient ses actions. Lorsqu'on examine l'évolution du rôle d'intermédiation et les niveaux d'influence contestés, les fonctions de gouvernance ou de représentation de la NBA apparaissent plus symbiotiques qu'oppositionnelles, la NBA utilisant la réalisation de l'une pour renforcer l'exécution de l'autre. Dans l'ensemble, l'analyse présentée dans cet article met en lumière la fragilité fonctionnelle du NBA, ce qui amène à se demander si les appels répétés enjoignant aux organismes comptables professionnels de redécouvrir leur mandat de protection de l'intérêt public ont pleinement pris en compte la nature complexe et contestée de l'environnement réglementaire dans lequel ils exercent leurs activités.

before.title_zh: 危机时期的监管中介：独立监督对专业会计机构运作的影响
before.abstract_zh: 对会计行业独立监督的兴起已吸引了大量研究关注。这些研究大多考察了职业会计团体和四大（Big 4）事务所如何塑造独立监督机构的授权与能力。对于独立监督如何影响职业会计团体的运作，尤其是其同时治理和代表成员的能力，人们所知较少。本文通过一项纵向、解释性案例研究，推进了我们对这一动态的理解，该案例研究考察了荷兰职业会计团体NBA（荷兰皇家特许会计师协会）在荷兰监管机构AFM（金融市场管理局）长期高强度监督以及四大（Big 4）事务所分歧程度不断变化的时期，如何调整和发展其监管中介角色。基于大量档案材料以及对关键参与者的深度访谈所获得的洞见，本研究推进了关于监管中介工作的现有理论化，突出了其功能上的可变性与脆弱性。在应对反复出现的危机和批评时，NBA的中介角色从促进转向策展，并最终转向协调四大（Big 4）事务所的监管回应。此类转变既非平稳也非可预测——其特征是一种“角色悬置”感，因为当NBA被AFM边缘化，或被四大（Big 4）事务所支配或阻碍时，它努力巩固自身的身份与权威。在考察这种不断变化的中介活动以及相互争夺的影响力水平时，NBA的治理与代表职能显现出更多是共生关系而非对立关系，NBA将履行其中一项职能作为加强另一项职能执行的手段。总体而言，本文的分析揭示了NBA的功能脆弱性，这使人质疑，反复呼吁职业会计团体重新发现其公共利益使命，是否充分认识到它们所运作的监管环境的复杂且充满争议的性质。

Lorsqu'on examine l'évolution du rôle d'intermédiation et les niveaux d'influence contestés, les fonctions de gouvernance ou de représentation de la NBA apparaissent plus symbiotiques qu'oppositionnelles, la NBA utilisant la réalisation de l'une pour renforcer l'exécution de l'autre. Dans l'ensemble, l'analyse présentée dans cet article met en lumière la fragilité fonctionnelle du NBA, ce qui amène à se demander si les appels répétés enjoignant aux organismes comptables professionnels de redécouvrir leur mandat de protection de l'intérêt public ont pleinement pris en compte la nature complexe et contestée de l'environnement réglementaire dans lequel ils exercent leurs activités.

existing_records.title: Regulatory Intermediation in Times of Crisis: The Impact of Independent Oversight on the Functioning of Professional Accounting Bodies
existing_records.abstract: The rise of independent oversight of the accounting profession has attracted considerable research attention. Much of this research has studied how professional accounting bodies and the Big 4 firms have shaped the mandate and capabilities of independent oversight bodies. Less is known about how independent oversight has affected the workings of professional accounting bodies, particularly their capacity to simultaneously govern and represent their members. This paper advances our understanding of this dynamic through a longitudinal, interpretive case study of how the Dutch professional accounting body, the NBA (the Royal Netherlands Institute of Chartered Accountants), adapted and developed its regulatory intermediary role during a lengthy period of intense oversight by the Dutch regulator, the AFM (the Authority for the Financial Markets), and shifting levels of Big 4 firm discord. Drawing on extensive archival materials and insights gained from in‐depth interviews with key participants, the study advances existing theorizations of the work of regulatory intermediaries by highlighting both their functional variability and fragility. In responding to recurring crises and critique, the NBA's intermediary role shifted from facilitation to curation and ultimately to orchestrating the Big 4 firms' regulatory response. Such shifts were neither smooth nor predictable—characterized by a sense of “role limbo” as the NBA battled to bolster its identity and authority when sidelined by the AFM or dictated to or impeded by the Big 4 firms. In examining such shifting intermediation and contesting levels of influence, the NBA's governance and representation functions emerge as more symbiotic than oppositional, with the NBA using its fulfillment of one as a means of strengthening its execution of the other. Overall, the paper's analysis uncovers the functional fragility of the NBA, which questions whether repeated calls for professional accounting bodies to rediscover their public interest mandate have adequately appreciated the complex, contested nature of the regulatory environment in which they operate.

after.title_zh: 危机时期的监管中介：独立监督对专业会计机构运作的影响
after.abstract_zh: 对会计行业独立监督的兴起已吸引了大量研究关注。这些研究大多考察了职业会计团体和四大（Big 4）事务所如何塑造独立监督机构的授权与能力。对于独立监督如何影响职业会计团体的运作，尤其是其同时治理和代表成员的能力，人们所知较少。本文通过一项纵向、解释性案例研究，推进了我们对这一动态的理解，该案例研究考察了荷兰职业会计团体NBA（荷兰皇家特许会计师协会）在荷兰监管机构AFM（金融市场管理局）长期高强度监督以及四大（Big 4）事务所分歧程度不断变化的时期，如何调整和发展其监管中介角色。基于大量档案材料以及对关键参与者的深度访谈所获得的洞见，本研究推进了关于监管中介工作的现有理论化，突出了其功能上的可变性与脆弱性。在应对反复出现的危机和批评时，NBA的中介角色从促进转向策展，并最终转向协调四大（Big 4）事务所的监管回应。此类转变既非平稳也非可预测——其特征是一种“角色悬置”感，因为当NBA被AFM边缘化，或被四大（Big 4）事务所支配或阻碍时，它努力巩固自身的身份与权威。在考察这种不断变化的中介活动以及相互争夺的影响力水平时，NBA的治理与代表职能显现出更多是共生关系而非对立关系，NBA将履行其中一项职能作为加强另一项职能执行的手段。总体而言，本文的分析揭示了NBA的功能脆弱性，这使人质疑，反复呼吁职业会计团体重新发现其公共利益使命，是否充分认识到它们所运作的监管环境的复杂且充满争议的性质。

source_records.title: SEC Attention, A to Z
source_records.abstract: I use downloads of regulatory filings by SEC employees as a measure of SEC attention and find that SEC employees are disproportionately less likely to review the filings of firms with names later in the alphabet. Additional tests show that alphabetical order determines a firm's priority when the SEC follows up on common shocks among peer firms and that the strength of the SEC's alphabetical bias does not vary with the intensity of resource constraints. Further, the SEC appears to be more surprised by the restatements of end‐of‐the‐alphabet firms. These results are consistent with a cognitive bias that leads SEC employees to pay more attention to firms at the top of alphabetically sorted lists. Last, using shocks to alphabetical order caused by firm name changes, I find that alphabetically induced increases in SEC attention are linked with lower future noncompliance, suggesting that the regulatory effects of alphabetical order are material. Overall, this study highlights the “human” element of regulatory attention.

source_records.raw_title: SEC Attention, A to ZL'attention de la SEC, de A à Z
source_records.raw_abstract:
ABSTRACT
I use downloads of regulatory filings by SEC employees as a measure of SEC attention and find that SEC employees are disproportionately less likely to review the filings of firms with names later in the alphabet. Additional tests show that alphabetical order determines a firm's priority when the SEC follows up on common shocks among peer firms and that the strength of the SEC's alphabetical bias does not vary with the intensity of resource constraints. Further, the SEC appears to be more surprised by the restatements of end‐of‐the‐alphabet firms. These results are consistent with a cognitive bias that leads SEC employees to pay more attention to firms at the top of alphabetically sorted lists. Last, using shocks to alphabetical order caused by firm name changes, I find that alphabetically induced increases in SEC attention are linked with lower future noncompliance, suggesting that the regulatory effects of alphabetical order are material. Overall, this study highlights the “human” element of regulatory attention.

RÉSUMÉ
L'auteure utilise des téléchargements de déclarations effectués par les employés de la SEC comme indicateur de l'attention de la SEC, et constate que les employés de cette autorité de réglementation sont nettement moins enclins à examiner les déclarations des entreprises dont le nom se situe à la fin de l'alphabet. Des tests supplémentaires démontrent que l'ordre alphabétique détermine la priorité accordée à une entreprise lorsque la SEC assure le suivi de chocs communs auprès d'entreprises homologues. La forte présence, à la SEC, d'un biais associé à l'ordre alphabétique reste persistante, indépendamment de l'intensité des limites financières. Par ailleurs, la SEC semble plus étonnée des retraitements comptables des entreprises situées à la fin de l'alphabet. Ces résultats corroborent la présence d'un biais cognitif incitant les employés de la SEC à prêter davantage attention aux entreprises figurant en tête des listes alphabétiques. Enfin, en utilisant les chocs sur l'ordre alphabétique causés par les changements de nom d'entreprise, l'auteure constate que les augmentations du niveau d'attention de la SEC générées par l'ordre alphabétique sont corrélées à une baisse future de la non‐conformité, suggérant que les effets liés à l'ordre alphabétique sont significatifs au sein des autorités de réglementation. En somme, cette étude met en évidence la dimension « humaine » inhérente à l'attention des autorités de réglementation.

before.title_zh: SEC关注，从A到Z
before.abstract_zh: 我使用SEC雇员对监管文件的下载量作为衡量SEC关注度的指标，发现SEC雇员审查名称在字母表中较靠后公司文件的可能性不成比例地更低。进一步测试表明，当SEC对同行业公司间的共同冲击进行跟进时，字母顺序决定了公司的优先级，并且SEC字母顺序偏好的强度不随资源约束的强度而变化。此外，SEC似乎对字母表末尾公司的重述感到更为意外。这些结果与一种认知偏差相一致，该偏差导致SEC雇员更关注按字母顺序排列的列表中靠前的公司。最后，利用公司名称变更引起的字母顺序冲击，我发现字母顺序引发的SEC关注度增加与未来更低的违规行为相关，这表明字母顺序的监管效应是重大的。总体而言，本研究凸显了监管关注中的“人”的因素。

after.title_zh: SEC关注，从A到Z
after.abstract_zh: 我使用SEC雇员对监管文件的下载量作为衡量SEC关注度的指标，发现SEC雇员审查名称在字母表中较靠后公司文件的可能性不成比例地更低。进一步测试表明，当SEC对同行业公司间的共同冲击进行跟进时，字母顺序决定了公司的优先级，并且SEC字母顺序偏好的强度不随资源约束的强度而变化。此外，SEC似乎对字母表末尾公司的重述感到更为意外。这些结果与一种认知偏差相一致，该偏差导致SEC雇员更关注按字母顺序排列的列表中靠前的公司。最后，利用公司名称变更引起的字母顺序冲击，我发现字母顺序引发的SEC关注度增加与未来更低的违规行为相关，这表明字母顺序的监管效应是重大的。总体而言，本研究凸显了监管关注中的“人”的因素。

source_records.raw_title: Cost Information, Insider Trading, and Product Market EquilibriumRenseignements sur les coûts, opération d'initié et équilibre du marché des produits
source_records.raw_abstract:
ABSTRACT
We study how insider trading based on private cost information affects product market outcomes when firms differ in cost variance. In our model, managers exploit firm‐specific cost information to pursue short‐term trading gains, leading them to adjust output decisions and reshape product market competition. We show that trading opportunities have heterogeneous effects on firms' production and value: firms with high cost variance overproduce, whereas those with low cost variance underproduce; correspondingly, the value of firms with high cost variance rises, while that of firms with low cost variance declines. These results demonstrate how heterogeneous costs and private cost information create real economic consequences by linking insider trading incentives to distortions in product market competition and firm value.

RÉSUMÉ
Les auteurs se demandent comment l'opération d'initié liée aux renseignements confidentiels sur les coûts influe sur les effets du marché des produits lorsque les entreprises présentent des différences de coûts. Ils proposent un modèle dans lequel les gestionnaires utilisent des renseignements sur les coûts propres à leur entreprise pour réaliser des opérations à court terme, ce qui les incite à réévaluer leurs décisions de production, modifiant ainsi les dynamiques de concurrence sur le marché des produits. Les auteurs démontrent que les possibilités de négociation ont des effets hétérogènes sur la production et la valeur des entreprises : les entreprises présentant un haut degré de différence de coûts tendent à surproduire, tandis que celles présentant un faible degré de différence de coûts tendent à sous‐produire ; par conséquent, la valeur des premières augmente, tandis que celle des secondes diminue. Ces résultats démontrent la manière dont l'hétérogénéité des coûts et des renseignements confidentiels sur les coûts entraîne des conséquences économiques réelles, en faisant le lien entre les incitations à l'opération d'initié et les distorsions de la concurrence sur le marché des produits et de la valeur des entreprises.

before.title_zh: 成本信息、内幕交易与产品市场均衡
before.abstract_zh: 我们研究基于私人成本信息的内幕交易如何影响产品市场结果，当企业的成本方差不同时。在我们的模型中，管理者利用企业特定的成本信息来追求短期交易收益，导致他们调整产出决策并重塑产品市场竞争。我们表明，交易机会对企业的生产和价值具有异质性影响：成本方差高的企业过度生产，而成本方差低的企业生产不足；相应地，成本方差高的企业价值上升，而成本方差低的企业价值下降。这些结果表明，异质性成本和私人成本信息如何通过将内幕交易激励与产品市场竞争和企业价值的扭曲联系起来，产生实际经济后果。

existing_records.title: Cost Information, Insider Trading, and Product Market Equilibrium
existing_records.abstract: We study how insider trading based on private cost information affects product market outcomes when firms differ in cost variance. In our model, managers exploit firm‐specific cost information to pursue short‐term trading gains, leading them to adjust output decisions and reshape product market competition. We show that trading opportunities have heterogeneous effects on firms' production and value: firms with high cost variance overproduce, whereas those with low cost variance underproduce; correspondingly, the value of firms with high cost variance rises, while that of firms with low cost variance declines. These results demonstrate how heterogeneous costs and private cost information create real economic consequences by linking insider trading incentives to distortions in product market competition and firm value.

source_records.raw_title: The Questioning of Special Items During Conference Calls: High Quality or Highly Questionable?Réexaminer des éléments exceptionnels lors des conférences téléphoniques : une pratique d'excellence ou très contestable?
source_records.raw_abstract:
ABSTRACT
Accounting standards require firms to distinguish recurring revenues and expenses from nonrecurring gains and losses, which are often referred to as special items. However, not all special items are genuinely nonrecurring. Exploiting the setting of earnings conference calls, we explore whether analysts can identify opportunistic special items, as evidenced by asking for more information about them. We find evidence that managers' discussions of special items more often relate to predicted special items, whereas analysts have more questions about potentially opportunistic special items. Managers adopt a relatively more negative tone and use more words when answering questions about potentially opportunistic special items. Finally, we find that analysts who question potentially opportunistic special items have fewer opportunities to speak in the subsequent call, consistent with managerial retaliation.

RÉSUMÉ
Les normes comptables exigent des entreprises qu'elles distinguent les recettes ordinaires et les charges récurrentes des pertes et gains non récurrents, souvent qualifiés d'éléments exceptionnels. Toutefois, certains éléments exceptionnels ne sont pas réellement non récurrents. À partir de données issues de conférences téléphoniques sur les résultats, cette étude examine la capacité des analystes à identifier les éléments exceptionnels opportunistes, mise en évidence par un accroissement de leurs demandes d'informations. Les résultats démontrent que les discussions des gestionnaires sur les éléments exceptionnels portent plus souvent sur des éléments exceptionnels prévus, tandis que les analystes posent davantage de questions sur les éléments exceptionnels présumés opportunistes. Les gestionnaires adoptent un ton relativement plus déplaisant et utilisent davantage de mots lorsqu'ils répondent à des questions sur des éléments exceptionnels présumés opportunistes. Enfin, l'étude révèle que les analystes qui remettent en question des éléments exceptionnels présumés opportunistes ont moins d'occasions de s'exprimer lors de la conférence téléphonique ultérieure, ce qui correspond à une forme de représailles de la part de la direction.

before.title_zh: 电话会议中对特殊项目的质疑：高质量还是高度可疑？
before.abstract_zh: 会计准则要求企业将经常性收入和费用与非经常性损益区分开来，后者通常被称为特殊项目。然而，并非所有特殊项目都真正是非经常性的。利用收益电话会议这一情境，我们探讨分析师能否识别机会主义特殊项目，其证据是分析师是否会就这些项目索取更多信息。我们发现证据表明，管理者对特殊项目的讨论更多与预测的特殊项目相关，而分析师则对潜在的机会主义特殊项目提出更多问题。在回答有关潜在机会主义特殊项目的问题时，管理者采用相对更为负面的语气并使用更多词语。最后，我们发现，对潜在机会主义特殊项目提出质疑的分析师在随后的电话会议中获得发言的机会更少，这与管理者报复行为相一致。

Toutefois, certains éléments exceptionnels ne sont pas réellement non récurrents. À partir de données issues de conférences téléphoniques sur les résultats, cette étude examine la capacité des analystes à identifier les éléments exceptionnels opportunistes, mise en évidence par un accroissement de leurs demandes d'informations. Les résultats démontrent que les discussions des gestionnaires sur les éléments exceptionnels portent plus souvent sur des éléments exceptionnels prévus, tandis que les analystes posent davantage de questions sur les éléments exceptionnels présumés opportunistes. Les gestionnaires adoptent un ton relativement plus déplaisant et utilisent davantage de mots lorsqu'ils répondent à des questions sur des éléments exceptionnels présumés opportunistes. Enfin, l'étude révèle que les analystes qui remettent en question des éléments exceptionnels présumés opportunistes ont moins d'occasions de s'exprimer lors de la conférence téléphonique ultérieure, ce qui correspond à une forme de représailles de la part de la direction.

after.title_zh: 电话会议中对特殊项目的质疑：高质量还是高度可疑？
after.abstract_zh: 会计准则要求企业将经常性收入和费用与非经常性损益区分开来，后者通常被称为特殊项目。然而，并非所有特殊项目都真正是非经常性的。利用收益电话会议这一情境，我们探讨分析师能否识别机会主义特殊项目，其证据是分析师是否会就这些项目索取更多信息。我们发现证据表明，管理者对特殊项目的讨论更多与预测的特殊项目相关，而分析师则对潜在的机会主义特殊项目提出更多问题。在回答有关潜在机会主义特殊项目的问题时，管理者采用相对更为负面的语气并使用更多词语。最后，我们发现，对潜在机会主义特殊项目提出质疑的分析师在随后的电话会议中获得发言的机会更少，这与管理者报复行为相一致。

source_records.title: The Falling Roe and Relocation of Skilled Women
source_records.abstract: We examine the impact of abortion restrictions on the geographic mobility of college‐educated skilled women. Exploiting the staggered adoption of Targeted Regulation of Abortion Providers (TRAP) laws across US states that restrict women's access to abortion, we find that skilled women who relocate exhibit a greater propensity to move to states without TRAP laws (non‐TRAP states) than they did prior to the TRAP law adoption. This pattern is stronger among women in more liberal and less religious areas than among women in more conservative and more religious areas. These findings are consistent with the view that relocation decisions are often driven by the alignment between personal values and the local policy environment. We use the audit industry as a specific setting to address the implications for employer performance. We find that TRAP law adoption increases female auditor turnover at local offices relative to same‐firm offices in non‐TRAP states, and the resulting loss of human capital lowers audit quality.

source_records.raw_abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>We examine the impact of abortion restrictions on the geographic mobility of college‐educated skilled women. Exploiting the staggered adoption of Targeted Regulation of Abortion Providers (TRAP) laws across US states that restrict women's access to abortion, we find that skilled women who relocate exhibit a greater propensity to move to states without TRAP laws (non‐TRAP states) than they did prior to the TRAP law adoption. This pattern is stronger among women in more liberal and less religious areas than among women in more conservative and more religious areas. These findings are consistent with the view that relocation decisions are often driven by the alignment between personal values and the local policy environment. We use the audit industry as a specific setting to address the implications for employer performance. We find that TRAP law adoption increases female auditor turnover at local offices relative to same‐firm offices in non‐TRAP states, and the resulting loss of human capital lowers audit quality.</jats:p>

before.title_zh: 罗伊案被推翻与技能女性的迁移
before.abstract_zh: 我们考察堕胎限制对受过大学教育的技能女性地理流动性的影响。利用美国各州交错采用针对堕胎服务提供者的定向监管（TRAP）法律——这些法律限制女性获得堕胎服务——我们发现，与TRAP法律通过之前相比，迁移的技能女性更倾向于迁往没有TRAP法律的州（非TRAP州）。这一模式在更自由派和宗教氛围较弱地区的女性中，比在更保守和宗教氛围较强地区的女性中更为明显。这些发现与以下观点一致：迁移决策往往由个人价值观与当地政策环境之间的一致性所驱动。我们以审计行业作为具体情境来探讨对雇主绩效的影响。我们发现，TRAP法律的通过提高了当地办事处相对于非TRAP州同一公司办事处的女性审计师流失率，由此造成的人力资本损失降低了审计质量。

Exploiting the staggered adoption of Targeted Regulation of Abortion Providers (TRAP) laws across US states that restrict women's access to abortion, we find that skilled women who relocate exhibit a greater propensity to move to states without TRAP laws (non‐TRAP states) than they did prior to the TRAP law adoption. This pattern is stronger among women in more liberal and less religious areas than among women in more conservative and more religious areas. These findings are consistent with the view that relocation decisions are often driven by the alignment between personal values and the local policy environment. We use the audit industry as a specific setting to address the implications for employer performance. We find that TRAP law adoption increases female auditor turnover at local offices relative to same‐firm offices in non‐TRAP states, and the resulting loss of human capital lowers audit quality.

after.abstract_zh: 我们考察堕胎限制对受过大学教育的技能女性地理流动性的影响。利用美国各州交错采用针对堕胎服务提供者的定向监管（TRAP）法律——这些法律限制女性获得堕胎服务——我们发现，与TRAP法律通过之前相比，迁移的技能女性更倾向于迁往没有TRAP法律的州（非TRAP州）。这一模式在更自由派和宗教氛围较弱地区的女性中，比在更保守和宗教氛围较强地区的女性中更为明显。这些发现与以下观点一致：迁移决策往往由个人价值观与当地政策环境之间的一致性所驱动。我们以审计行业作为具体情境来探讨对雇主绩效的影响。我们发现，TRAP法律的通过提高了当地办事处相对于非TRAP州同一公司办事处的女性审计师流失率，由此造成的人力资本损失降低了审计质量。

existing_records.title: The Falling Roe and Relocation of Skilled Women
existing_records.abstract: We examine the impact of abortion restrictions on the geographic mobility of college‐educated skilled women. Exploiting the staggered adoption of Targeted Regulation of Abortion Providers (TRAP) laws across US states that restrict women's access to abortion, we find that skilled women who relocate exhibit a greater propensity to move to states without TRAP laws (non‐TRAP states) than they did prior to the TRAP law adoption. This pattern is stronger among women in more liberal and less religious areas than among women in more conservative and more religious areas. These findings are consistent with the view that relocation decisions are often driven by the alignment between personal values and the local policy environment. We use the audit industry as a specific setting to address the implications for employer performance. We find that TRAP law adoption increases female auditor turnover at local offices relative to same‐firm offices in non‐TRAP states, and the resulting loss of human capital lowers audit quality.

source_records.title: Behind Closed Doors: Interaction Rituals and the Building of Social Ties in Private Company‐Investor Meetings
source_records.abstract: This paper examines private meetings between company managers and institutional investors as part of the broader financial reporting environment. Using direct observations of 39 such meetings across four large, listed companies—complemented with the study of preparatory work and internal documents—the paper investigates how these meetings help build and maintain relationships between companies and investors. The analysis shows that the importance of these meetings lies not primarily in the exchange of new information but in the creation of familiarity, focused engagement, and exclusivity, which strengthen social ties and reinforce participants' positions in the capital market. Drawing on interaction ritual theory, the paper identifies three forms of ritual work through which these outcomes are produced: assembly work, conversational work, and bodily work. The study contributes to research on the social embeddedness of capital markets and suggests that private reporting meetings should be understood not only as informational events but also as relational mechanisms that shape access, trust, and network persistence.

source_records.raw_abstract:
ABSTRACT
This paper examines private meetings between company managers and institutional investors as part of the broader financial reporting environment. Using direct observations of 39 such meetings across four large, listed companies—complemented with the study of preparatory work and internal documents—the paper investigates how these meetings help build and maintain relationships between companies and investors. The analysis shows that the importance of these meetings lies not primarily in the exchange of new information but in the creation of familiarity, focused engagement, and exclusivity, which strengthen social ties and reinforce participants' positions in the capital market. Drawing on interaction ritual theory, the paper identifies three forms of ritual work through which these outcomes are produced: assembly work, conversational work, and bodily work. The study contributes to research on the social embeddedness of capital markets and suggests that private reporting meetings should be understood not only as informational events but also as relational mechanisms that shape access, trust, and network persistence.

RÉSUMÉ
Cet article porte sur les réunions privées entre dirigeants de sociétés et investisseurs institutionnels, dans le contexte élargi de l'information financière. En s'appuyant sur l'observation directe de 39 réunions de ce type au sein de quatre grandes sociétés cotées — complétée par l'étude de travaux préparatoires et de documents internes — l'article analyse la manière dont ces réunions visent à établir et à entretenir les relations entre les sociétés et les investisseurs. L'analyse montre que l'importance de ces réunions ne réside pas principalement dans l'échange de nouvelles informations, mais dans la création d'une familiarité, d'un engagement ciblé et d'une exclusivité, qui renforcent les liens sociaux et consolident la position des participants sur le marché financier. En se basant sur la théorie du rituel d'interaction, cet article identifie trois catégories de rituels de travail par lesquels ces résultats sont produits : le travail d'assemblage, le travail conversationnel et le travail corporel. Cette étude contribue à la recherche sur l'intégration sociale des marchés financiers et suggère que les réunions privées consacrées à l'information doivent être considérées non seulement comme des événements informationnels, mais aussi comme des mécanismes relationnels qui façonnent l'accès, la confiance et la pérennité des réseaux.

before.title_zh: 闭门之后：私人公司-投资者会议中的互动仪式与社会联系的建立
before.abstract_zh: 本文考察公司管理层与机构投资者之间的私下会面，将其视为更广泛财务报告环境的一部分。本文通过对四家大型上市公司中39次此类会面的直接观察——并辅以对准备工作和内部文件的研究——探讨了这些会面如何帮助建立和维持公司与投资者之间的关系。分析表明，这些会面的重要性主要不在于交换新信息，而在于创造熟悉感、专注参与和排他性，从而加强社会联系并巩固参与者在资本市场中的地位。本文借鉴互动仪式理论，识别出产生这些结果的三种仪式工作形式：集会工作、对话工作和身体工作。本研究对资本市场社会嵌入性研究有所贡献，并表明私下报告会面不仅应被理解为信息性事件，还应被理解为塑造准入、信任和网络持续性的关系机制。

after.title_zh: 闭门之后：私人公司-投资者会议中的互动仪式与社会联系的建立
after.abstract_zh: 本文考察公司管理层与机构投资者之间的私下会面，将其视为更广泛财务报告环境的一部分。本文通过对四家大型上市公司中39次此类会面的直接观察——并辅以对准备工作和内部文件的研究——探讨了这些会面如何帮助建立和维持公司与投资者之间的关系。分析表明，这些会面的重要性主要不在于交换新信息，而在于创造熟悉感、专注参与和排他性，从而加强社会联系并巩固参与者在资本市场中的地位。本文借鉴互动仪式理论，识别出产生这些结果的三种仪式工作形式：集会工作、对话工作和身体工作。本研究对资本市场社会嵌入性研究有所贡献，并表明私下报告会面不仅应被理解为信息性事件，还应被理解为塑造准入、信任和网络持续性的关系机制。

existing_records.title: Behind Closed Doors: Interaction Rituals and the Building of Social Ties in Private Company‐Investor Meetings
existing_records.abstract: This paper examines private meetings between company managers and institutional investors as part of the broader financial reporting environment. Using direct observations of 39 such meetings across four large, listed companies—complemented with the study of preparatory work and internal documents—the paper investigates how these meetings help build and maintain relationships between companies and investors. The analysis shows that the importance of these meetings lies not primarily in the exchange of new information but in the creation of familiarity, focused engagement, and exclusivity, which strengthen social ties and reinforce participants' positions in the capital market. Drawing on interaction ritual theory, the paper identifies three forms of ritual work through which these outcomes are produced: assembly work, conversational work, and bodily work. The study contributes to research on the social embeddedness of capital markets and suggests that private reporting meetings should be understood not only as informational events but also as relational mechanisms that shape access, trust, and network persistence.

source_records.title: Analyst Integrity
source_records.abstract: We empirically investigate the impact of financial analysts' integrity on their information outputs and career success. Using analysts' off‐the‐job behavior, specifically their legal records, to proxy for analyst integrity, we predict and find that weak‐integrity analysts engage more in opportunistic behaviors, including “speaking in two tongues” and earnings forecast walk‐down. These analysts obtain favorable management access and make more accurate earnings forecasts. Further analyses indicate that while the market as a whole does not distinguish weak‐integrity analysts from others, sophisticated investors discount their information outputs. Weak‐integrity analysts also experience less favorable career outcomes. Our results have important implications for investors, professional bodies, employers, and regulators.

before.title_zh: 分析师诚信
before.abstract_zh: 我们实证研究了金融分析师的诚信对其信息产出和职业成功的影响。我们使用分析师的业余行为，具体而言是其法律记录，作为分析师诚信的代理变量，预测并发现诚信较弱的分析师更多从事机会主义行为，包括“两面三刀”和盈利预测下调。这些分析师获得了有利的管理层接触机会，并做出更准确的盈利预测。进一步分析表明，尽管市场整体并不区分诚信较弱的分析师与其他分析师，但成熟投资者会对其信息产出打折扣。诚信较弱的分析师也经历较不利的职业结果。我们的结果对投资者、专业机构、雇主和监管机构具有重要启示。

existing_records.title: Analyst Integrity
existing_records.abstract: We empirically investigate the impact of financial analysts' integrity on their information outputs and career success. Using analysts' off‐the‐job behavior, specifically their legal records, to proxy for analyst integrity, we predict and find that weak‐integrity analysts engage more in opportunistic behaviors, including “speaking in two tongues” and earnings forecast walk‐down. These analysts obtain favorable management access and make more accurate earnings forecasts. Further analyses indicate that while the market as a whole does not distinguish weak‐integrity analysts from others, sophisticated investors discount their information outputs. Weak‐integrity analysts also experience less favorable career outcomes. Our results have important implications for investors, professional bodies, employers, and regulators.

after.title_zh: 分析师诚信
after.abstract_zh: 我们实证研究了金融分析师的诚信对其信息产出和职业成功的影响。我们使用分析师的业余行为，具体而言是其法律记录，作为分析师诚信的代理变量，预测并发现诚信较弱的分析师更多从事机会主义行为，包括“两面三刀”和盈利预测下调。这些分析师获得了有利的管理层接触机会，并做出更准确的盈利预测。进一步分析表明，尽管市场整体并不区分诚信较弱的分析师与其他分析师，但成熟投资者会对其信息产出打折扣。诚信较弱的分析师也经历较不利的职业结果。我们的结果对投资者、专业机构、雇主和监管机构具有重要启示。

source_records.title: From Words to Actions: The Impact of Specificity and Causality in Narrative Feedback on Employee Performance Improvement
source_records.abstract: With the widespread use of narrative feedback in companies, understanding how such feedback can be valuable for employee performance improvement is important. Drawing on proprietary data from an e‐commerce company, we investigate the role of specificity and causality—two key language characteristics for self‐regulation and learning. Our findings suggest that neither specificity nor causality is always beneficial; instead, their effects depend on whether the feedback refers to strengths or weaknesses. Specifically, employees are more likely to improve when they receive more specific narrative feedback on their strengths, consistent with employees engaging in more systematic exploration when feedback provides concrete references to desirable behaviors. In contrast, we find that increases in the specificity of narrative feedback on weaknesses can have negative performance consequences, as employees who are confronted with many specific examples of undesirable behaviors may attempt too many behavioral changes at once, undermining learning and improvement. Furthermore, employees are more likely to improve when feedback on their weaknesses uses more causal language, suggesting that explanations of why certain behaviors were ineffective help employees understand and correct those behaviors. Our study informs HR leaders, supervisors, and experts responsible for designing management control systems by showing that narrative feedback should be specific when describing strengths, but more selective and richer in causal explanations when addressing weaknesses.

before.title_zh: 从言语到行动：叙事反馈中的具体性与因果性对员工绩效改进的影响
before.abstract_zh: 随着叙事反馈在企业中的广泛使用，理解此类反馈如何对员工绩效改进具有价值十分重要。基于一家电子商务公司的专有数据，我们考察了具体性与因果性——这两个对自我调节和学习至关重要的关键语言特征——的作用。我们的研究结果表明，具体性和因果性并非总是有益的；相反，它们的效果取决于反馈是指向优势还是劣势。具体而言，当员工收到关于其优势的更具体的叙事反馈时，他们更有可能改进，这与员工在反馈为可取行为提供具体参照时进行更系统性探索的情况一致。相比之下，我们发现，关于劣势的叙事反馈具体性的增加可能对绩效产生负面影响，因为面对许多具体的不良行为实例的员工可能试图一次性做出过多行为改变，从而损害学习和改进。此外，当关于劣势的反馈使用更多因果性语言时，员工更有可能改进，这表明对某些行为为何无效的解释有助于员工理解和纠正这些行为。我们的研究为负责设计管理控制系统的HR领导者、主管和专家提供了启示，表明叙事反馈在描述优势时应具体，而在处理劣势时应更具选择性并包含更丰富的因果解释。

existing_records.title: From Words to Actions: The Impact of Specificity and Causality in Narrative Feedback on Employee Performance Improvement
existing_records.abstract: With the widespread use of narrative feedback in companies, understanding how such feedback can be valuable for employee performance improvement is important. Drawing on proprietary data from an e‐commerce company, we investigate the role of specificity and causality—two key language characteristics for self‐regulation and learning. Our findings suggest that neither specificity nor causality is always beneficial; instead, their effects depend on whether the feedback refers to strengths or weaknesses. Specifically, employees are more likely to improve when they receive more specific narrative feedback on their strengths, consistent with employees engaging in more systematic exploration when feedback provides concrete references to desirable behaviors. In contrast, we find that increases in the specificity of narrative feedback on weaknesses can have negative performance consequences, as employees who are confronted with many specific examples of undesirable behaviors may attempt too many behavioral changes at once, undermining learning and improvement. Furthermore, employees are more likely to improve when feedback on their weaknesses uses more causal language, suggesting that explanations of why certain behaviors were ineffective help employees understand and correct those behaviors. Our study informs HR leaders, supervisors, and experts responsible for designing management control systems by showing that narrative feedback should be specific when describing strengths, but more selective and richer in causal explanations when addressing weaknesses.

after.title_zh: 从言语到行动：叙事反馈中的具体性与因果性对员工绩效改进的影响
after.abstract_zh: 随着叙事反馈在企业中的广泛使用，理解此类反馈如何对员工绩效改进具有价值十分重要。基于一家电子商务公司的专有数据，我们考察了具体性与因果性——这两个对自我调节和学习至关重要的关键语言特征——的作用。我们的研究结果表明，具体性和因果性并非总是有益的；相反，它们的效果取决于反馈是指向优势还是劣势。具体而言，当员工收到关于其优势的更具体的叙事反馈时，他们更有可能改进，这与员工在反馈为可取行为提供具体参照时进行更系统性探索的情况一致。相比之下，我们发现，关于劣势的叙事反馈具体性的增加可能对绩效产生负面影响，因为面对许多具体的不良行为实例的员工可能试图一次性做出过多行为改变，从而损害学习和改进。此外，当关于劣势的反馈使用更多因果性语言时，员工更有可能改进，这表明对某些行为为何无效的解释有助于员工理解和纠正这些行为。我们的研究为负责设计管理控制系统的HR领导者、主管和专家提供了启示，表明叙事反馈在描述优势时应具体，而在处理劣势时应更具选择性并包含更丰富的因果解释。

source_records.title: Black Representation Through the University to Audit Firm Pipeline
source_records.abstract: This study evaluates the auditing profession's diversity outcomes by comparing diversity along the university to job pipeline for auditing and other comparison disciplines. My tests show consistently anomalous outcomes for Black people in the audit labor pipeline, and therefore, I focus the study on them. I find that, among college freshmen planning to major in accounting, Black college freshmen are significantly overrepresented relative to freshmen planning to major in other business disciplines or nonbusiness disciplines. I find evidence of Black underrepresentation in the audit labor pipeline at every subsequent point: among accounting bachelor's and master's degree recipients, in the audit firm recruiting process, and among young professional auditors. My evidence of especially sharp Black attrition from accounting degree programs is, to my knowledge, novel. Although I lack sufficient data to pinpoint the mechanisms causing this sharp Black attrition from accounting degree programs, my findings are inconsistent with the popular theory that Black college students are distinctively uninterested in pursuing accounting education. It is not yet possible to make well‐targeted and data‐driven policy prescriptions to counter Black attrition from accounting degree programs because its causes are not well understood. Universities could contribute to the diagnosis process by systematically collecting and distributing data characterizing when and why students select away from accounting. My findings on audit firm recruiting are inconsistent with popular theories that Black underrepresentation in audit firms is attributable to overtly racially biased recruiters or lower interest among Black accounting graduates in pursuing careers in audit firms. Rather, my findings conform best with unintentionally biased recruiting by audit firms, which appear to make recruiting investments using outdated definitions of school quality. My evidence suggests that campus‐recruiting leaders within audit firms have the opportunity to hire more Black auditors without reducing the quality of the schools from which they recruit.

before.abstract_zh: 本研究通过比较审计学科与其他对照学科从大学到就业管道中的多样性，评估审计行业的多样性结果。我的检验显示，黑人在审计劳动力管道中持续出现异常结果，因此我将研究聚焦于他们。我发现，在计划主修会计的大学新生中，黑人大学新生相对于计划主修其他商科或非商科学科的新生显著过度代表。我发现有证据表明，在审计劳动力管道的每一个后续节点上，黑人都代表性不足：在会计学士和硕士学位获得者中、在审计事务所招聘过程中，以及在年轻专业审计人员中。据我所知，关于黑人从会计学位项目中异常严重流失的证据是新颖的。尽管我缺乏足够数据来精确识别导致黑人从会计学位项目中严重流失的机制，但我的发现与一种流行理论不一致，即黑人大学生对追求会计教育特别不感兴趣。目前尚不可能制定有针对性的、数据驱动的政策处方来应对黑人从会计学位项目中的流失，因为其原因尚未被充分理解。大学可以通过系统性地收集和发布数据来为诊断过程作出贡献，这些数据刻画学生何时以及为何选择离开会计。我关于审计事务所招聘的发现与流行理论不一致，这些理论认为黑人在审计事务所中代表性不足可归因于招聘人员公开的种族偏见或黑人会计毕业生对追求审计事务所职业的兴趣较低。相反，我的发现最符合审计事务所无意偏见的招聘，这些事务所似乎使用过时的学校质量定义进行招聘投资。我的证据表明，审计事务所内部的校园招聘负责人有机会在不降低其招聘学校质量的情况下雇用更多黑人审计人员。

source_records.title: Black Representation Through the University to Audit Firm Pipeline
source_records.abstract: This study evaluates the auditing profession's diversity outcomes by comparing diversity along the university to job pipeline for auditing and other comparison disciplines. My tests show consistently anomalous outcomes for Black people in the audit labor pipeline, and therefore, I focus the study on them. I find that, among college freshmen planning to major in accounting, Black college freshmen are significantly overrepresented relative to freshmen planning to major in other business disciplines or nonbusiness disciplines. I find evidence of Black underrepresentation in the audit labor pipeline at every subsequent point: among accounting bachelor's and master's degree recipients, in the audit firm recruiting process, and among young professional auditors. My evidence of especially sharp Black attrition from accounting degree programs is, to my knowledge, novel. Although I lack sufficient data to pinpoint the mechanisms causing this sharp Black attrition from accounting degree programs, my findings are inconsistent with the popular theory that Black college students are distinctively uninterested in pursuing accounting education. It is not yet possible to make well‐targeted and data‐driven policy prescriptions to counter Black attrition from accounting degree programs because its causes are not well understood. Universities could contribute to the diagnosis process by systematically collecting and distributing data characterizing when and why students select away from accounting. My findings on audit firm recruiting are inconsistent with popular theories that Black underrepresentation in audit firms is attributable to overtly racially biased recruiters or lower interest among Black accounting graduates in pursuing careers in audit firms. Rather, my findings conform best with unintentionally biased recruiting by audit firms, which appear to make recruiting investments using outdated definitions of school quality. My evidence suggests that campus‐recruiting leaders within audit firms have the opportunity to hire more Black auditors without reducing the quality of the schools from which they recruit.

after.title_zh: 从大学到审计事务所管道中的黑人代表性
after.abstract_zh: 本研究通过比较审计学科与其他对照学科从大学到就业管道中的多样性，评估审计行业的多样性结果。我的检验显示，黑人在审计劳动力管道中持续出现异常结果，因此我将研究聚焦于他们。我发现，在计划主修会计的大学新生中，黑人大学新生相对于计划主修其他商科或非商科学科的新生显著过度代表。我发现有证据表明，在审计劳动力管道的每一个后续节点上，黑人都代表性不足：在会计学士和硕士学位获得者中、在审计事务所招聘过程中，以及在年轻专业审计人员中。据我所知，关于黑人从会计学位项目中异常严重流失的证据是新颖的。尽管我缺乏足够数据来精确识别导致黑人从会计学位项目中严重流失的机制，但我的发现与一种流行理论不一致，即黑人大学生对追求会计教育特别不感兴趣。目前尚不可能制定有针对性的、数据驱动的政策处方来应对黑人从会计学位项目中的流失，因为其原因尚未被充分理解。大学可以通过系统性地收集和发布数据来为诊断过程作出贡献，这些数据刻画学生何时以及为何选择离开会计。我关于审计事务所招聘的发现与流行理论不一致，这些理论认为黑人在审计事务所中代表性不足可归因于招聘人员公开的种族偏见或黑人会计毕业生对追求审计事务所职业的兴趣较低。相反，我的发现最符合审计事务所无意偏见的招聘，这些事务所似乎使用过时的学校质量定义进行招聘投资。我的证据表明，审计事务所内部的校园招聘负责人有机会在不降低其招聘学校质量的情况下雇用更多黑人审计人员。

existing_records.title: Black Representation Through the University to Audit Firm Pipeline
existing_records.abstract: This study evaluates the auditing profession's diversity outcomes by comparing diversity along the university to job pipeline for auditing and other comparison disciplines. My tests show consistently anomalous outcomes for Black people in the audit labor pipeline, and therefore, I focus the study on them. I find that, among college freshmen planning to major in accounting, Black college freshmen are significantly overrepresented relative to freshmen planning to major in other business disciplines or nonbusiness disciplines. I find evidence of Black underrepresentation in the audit labor pipeline at every subsequent point: among accounting bachelor's and master's degree recipients, in the audit firm recruiting process, and among young professional auditors. My evidence of especially sharp Black attrition from accounting degree programs is, to my knowledge, novel. Although I lack sufficient data to pinpoint the mechanisms causing this sharp Black attrition from accounting degree programs, my findings are inconsistent with the popular theory that Black college students are distinctively uninterested in pursuing accounting education. It is not yet possible to make well‐targeted and data‐driven policy prescriptions to counter Black attrition from accounting degree programs because its causes are not well understood. Universities could contribute to the diagnosis process by systematically collecting and distributing data characterizing when and why students select away from accounting. My findings on audit firm recruiting are inconsistent with popular theories that Black underrepresentation in audit firms is attributable to overtly racially biased recruiters or lower interest among Black accounting graduates in pursuing careers in audit firms. Rather, my findings conform best with unintentionally biased recruiting by audit firms, which appear to make recruiting investments using outdated definitions of school quality. My evidence suggests that campus‐recruiting leaders within audit firms have the opportunity to hire more Black auditors without reducing the quality of the schools from which they recruit.

source_records.title: The Epistemic Rise of Accounting Research in Financial Economics: A Historical Study on the Conception of the Usefulness of Accounting
source_records.abstract: RÉSUMÉ L'étude publiée par Ball et Brown en 1968 (ci‐après « BB68 ») est principalement reconnue pour son affirmation selon laquelle la comptabilité de l'époque était utile pour les investisseurs, s'inscrivant alors en contradiction avec la littérature comptable normative faisant office d'autorité. Or, une telle affirmation n'allait pas de soi. Notre manuscrit vise à mieux comprendre comment l'affirmation initialement proposée dans BB68 en est venue à s'imposer au sein d'une branche importante de la littérature académique en comptabilité, à savoir la recherche comptable « empirique » en économie financière. Ainsi, nous réalisons une étude historique mobilisant certains concepts issus de la « sociologie de la traduction » pour examiner l'envolée de la recherche comptable en économie financière qui s'est déployée au fil des différentes réinterprétations de la notion d'utilité, où l'on est passé de l'évaluation boursière à l'encadrement de clauses contractuelles, en passant par la découverte des anomalies de marché. Nos analyses mettent en exergue, d'une part, le processus social entourant la naissance et le développement de la recherche comptable en économie financière et, d'autre part, la fragilité et le flou des prémisses sur lesquelles ce type de recherche s'est construit. Contrairement à la prétention selon laquelle la recherche comptable en économie financière s'est naturellement imposée en raison de sa supériorité sur le plan des connaissances, nous proposons que cette fragilité et ce flou, plutôt que de miner la crédibilité de ladite perspective, ont pu favoriser l'établissement d'un climat d'ambiguïté conceptuelle propice à sa prolifération. Cette ambiguïté s'articule sur deux plans : la mobilisation ambiguë de l'hypothèse de l'efficience des marchés et l'ambiguïté sémantique quant à la conception de l'utilité de l'information comptable. De façon plus générale, notre manuscrit alimente la discussion sur le cheminement des idées et le contrôle des frontières entourant certaines idées établies.

source_records.abstract: The study published by Ball and Brown in 1968 is mainly recognized for its assertion that the accounting of the time was useful to investors, which contradicted the normative accounting literature then considered the authority. This idea was not self-evident, and we aim in this paper to better understand how the assertion initially introduced in Ball and Brown's article became firmly established in an important stream of academic accounting literature: “empirical” accounting research in financial economics. We conduct a historical study, drawing on some concepts from the “sociology of translation,” to examine the rise of accounting research in financial economics, which unfolded through several reinterpretations of the concept of utility—shifting from stock market valuation to the framing of contractual clauses, in addition to the discovery of market anomalies. Contradicting the claim that accounting research in financial economics naturally prevailed due to its superiority in terms of knowledge, we argue that the fragility and vagueness of that perspective, instead of undermining its credibility, contributed to establishing a climate of conceptual ambiguity that was conducive to its propagation. This ambiguity is expressed at two levels: ambiguous mobilization of the efficient market hypothesis, and semantic ambiguity in the conception of the usefulness of accounting information. More generally, our article adds to the discussion of “travels of ideas” and “boundary gatekeeping” surrounding established ideas.

before.title_zh: 会计研究在金融经济学中的认识论崛起：关于会计有用性概念的历史研究
before.abstract_zh: Ball和Brown于1968年发表的研究，主要因其断言当时的会计对投资者是有用的而得到认可，这与当时被视为权威的规范性会计文献相矛盾。这一观点并非不言自明，本文旨在更好地理解Ball和Brown文章中最初提出的这一断言，如何在一个重要的学术会计文献流派——金融经济学中的“实证”会计研究——中牢固确立。我们进行了一项历史研究，借鉴“转译社会学”的一些概念，考察金融经济学中会计研究的兴起，这一兴起通过对效用概念的多次重新诠释而展开——从股票市场估值转向合同条款的构建，此外还有市场异象的发现。我们的分析一方面凸显了围绕金融经济学中会计研究出现和发展的社会过程，另一方面也凸显了此类研究所建基其上的基础的脆弱性和模糊性。与金融经济学中的会计研究因其在知识方面的优越性而自然胜出的主张相反，我们认为，该视角的脆弱性和模糊性非但没有削弱其可信度，反而有助于营造一种有利于其传播的概念模糊氛围。这种模糊性表现在两个层面：对有效市场假说的模糊动员，以及会计信息有用性概念上的语义模糊。更一般地说，我们的文章为围绕既定观念的“思想旅行”和“边界守门”的讨论增添了内容。

Nos analyses mettent en exergue, d'une part, le processus social entourant la naissance et le développement de la recherche comptable en économie financière et, d'autre part, la fragilité et le flou des prémisses sur lesquelles ce type de recherche s'est construit. Contrairement à la prétention selon laquelle la recherche comptable en économie financière s'est naturellement imposée en raison de sa supériorité sur le plan des connaissances, nous proposons que cette fragilité et ce flou, plutôt que de miner la crédibilité de ladite perspective, ont pu favoriser l'établissement d'un climat d'ambiguïté conceptuelle propice à sa prolifération. Cette ambiguïté s'articule sur deux plans : la mobilisation ambiguë de l'hypothèse de l'efficience des marchés et l'ambiguïté sémantique quant à la conception de l'utilité de l'information comptable. De façon plus générale, notre manuscrit alimente la discussion sur le cheminement des idées et le contrôle des frontières entourant certaines idées établies.

source_records.abstract: The study published by Ball and Brown in 1968 is mainly recognized for its assertion that the accounting of the time was useful to investors, which contradicted the normative accounting literature then considered the authority. This idea was not self-evident, and we aim in this paper to better understand how the assertion initially introduced in Ball and Brown's article became firmly established in an important stream of academic accounting literature: “empirical” accounting research in financial economics. We conduct a historical study, drawing on some concepts from the “sociology of translation,” to examine the rise of accounting research in financial economics, which unfolded through several reinterpretations of the concept of utility—shifting from stock market valuation to the framing of contractual clauses, in addition to the discovery of market anomalies. Contradicting the claim that accounting research in financial economics naturally prevailed due to its superiority in terms of knowledge, we argue that the fragility and vagueness of that perspective, instead of undermining its credibility, contributed to establishing a climate of conceptual ambiguity that was conducive to its propagation. This ambiguity is expressed at two levels: ambiguous mobilization of the efficient market hypothesis, and semantic ambiguity in the conception of the usefulness of accounting information. More generally, our article adds to the discussion of “travels of ideas” and “boundary gatekeeping” surrounding established ideas.

ABSTRACT
The study published by Ball and Brown in 1968 is mainly recognized for its assertion that the accounting of the time was useful to investors, which contradicted the normative accounting literature then considered the authority. This idea was not self-evident, and we aim in this paper to better understand how the assertion initially introduced in Ball and Brown's article became firmly established in an important stream of academic accounting literature: “empirical” accounting research in financial economics. We conduct a historical study, drawing on some concepts from the “sociology of translation,” to examine the rise of accounting research in financial economics, which unfolded through several reinterpretations of the concept of utility—shifting from stock market valuation to the framing of contractual clauses, in addition to the discovery of market anomalies. Our analyses highlight, on the one hand, the social processes surrounding the emergence and development of accounting research in financial economics and, on the other hand, the fragility and vagueness of the foundations upon which this type of research was built. Contradicting the claim that accounting research in financial economics naturally prevailed due to its superiority in terms of knowledge, we argue that the fragility and vagueness of that perspective, instead of undermining its credibility, contributed to establishing a climate of conceptual ambiguity that was conducive to its propagation. This ambiguity is expressed at two levels: ambiguous mobilization of the efficient market hypothesis, and semantic ambiguity in the conception of the usefulness of accounting information. More generally, our article adds to the discussion of “travels of ideas” and “boundary gatekeeping” surrounding established ideas.

after.title_zh: 会计研究在金融经济学中的认识论崛起：关于会计有用性概念的历史研究
after.abstract_zh: Ball和Brown于1968年发表的研究，主要因其断言当时的会计对投资者是有用的而得到认可，这与当时被视为权威的规范性会计文献相矛盾。这一观点并非不言自明，本文旨在更好地理解Ball和Brown文章中最初提出的这一断言，如何在一个重要的学术会计文献流派——金融经济学中的“实证”会计研究——中牢固确立。我们进行了一项历史研究，借鉴“转译社会学”的一些概念，考察金融经济学中会计研究的兴起，这一兴起通过对效用概念的多次重新诠释而展开——从股票市场估值转向合同条款的构建，此外还有市场异象的发现。我们的分析一方面凸显了围绕金融经济学中会计研究出现和发展的社会过程，另一方面也凸显了此类研究所建基其上的基础的脆弱性和模糊性。与金融经济学中的会计研究因其在知识方面的优越性而自然胜出的主张相反，我们认为，该视角的脆弱性和模糊性非但没有削弱其可信度，反而有助于营造一种有利于其传播的概念模糊氛围。这种模糊性表现在两个层面：对有效市场假说的模糊动员，以及会计信息有用性概念上的语义模糊。更一般地说，我们的文章为围绕既定观念的“思想旅行”和“边界守门”的讨论增添了内容。

existing_records.title: The Epistemic Rise of Accounting Research in Financial Economics: A Historical Study on the Conception of the Usefulness of Accounting
existing_records.abstract: The study published by Ball and Brown in 1968 is mainly recognized for its assertion that the accounting of the time was useful to investors, which contradicted the normative accounting literature then considered the authority. This idea was not self-evident, and we aim in this paper to better understand how the assertion initially introduced in Ball and Brown's article became firmly established in an important stream of academic accounting literature: “empirical” accounting research in financial economics. We conduct a historical study, drawing on some concepts from the “sociology of translation,” to examine the rise of accounting research in financial economics, which unfolded through several reinterpretations of the concept of utility—shifting from stock market valuation to the framing of contractual clauses, in addition to the discovery of market anomalies. Our analyses highlight, on the one hand, the social processes surrounding the emergence and development of accounting research in financial economics and, on the other hand, the fragility and vagueness of the foundations upon which this type of research was built. Contradicting the claim that accounting research in financial economics naturally prevailed due to its superiority in terms of knowledge, we argue that the fragility and vagueness of that perspective, instead of undermining its credibility, contributed to establishing a climate of conceptual ambiguity that was conducive to its propagation. This ambiguity is expressed at two levels: ambiguous mobilization of the efficient market hypothesis, and semantic ambiguity in the conception of the usefulness of accounting information. More generally, our article adds to the discussion of “travels of ideas” and “boundary gatekeeping” surrounding established ideas.
